At the main operating point, all three methods satisfy the constraint, with the reinforcement learning policy achieving the lowest benign-escalation fraction at 0.000, compared with 0.007 for the autoencoder and 0.041 for Isolation Forest. The methods also prioritize largely different alert clusters, showing complementary rather than redundant coverage. These results suggest that production SOC triage can benefit from constraint-aware evaluation and combined or adaptive deployment of different model families.
title_cn: 约束感知的安全运营告警分诊中强化学习与无监督异常检测评估
abstract_cn: 安全运营中心（SOC）必须从大量告警流中识别真实威胁，但分析师容量有限，不必要的升级会延误更严重事件的调查。现有研究常把 SOC 告警分诊框定为分类或异常检测，但对生产环境 SOC 而言两者都不完整：核心问题是在容量有限、错误代价不对称与工作负载约束下选择值得升级的告警。本文把告警分诊形式化为约束决策问题，并评估三种方法：在告警嵌入上训练的离线强化学习策略、基于运营特征构建的 Isolation Forest，以及在历史良性告警上训练的自编码器。这些方法代表不同的分诊假设：从奖励学习动作、隔离异常运营模式、检测与良性行为的偏离。我们在 74,909 条分析师标注的生产告警上、在严格时间切分与良性升级约束下评估所有方法。由于测试集含 503 个唯一特征模式，我们主要对相似告警簇排序。在主工作点上，三种方法都满足约束，其中强化学习策略取得最低的良性升级比例 0.000，自编码器为 0.007，Isolation Forest 为 0.041。各方法优先处理的告警簇也大不相同，表明互补而非冗余的覆盖。这些结果表明，生产 SOC 分诊可以从约束感知评估以及不同模型族的组合或自适应部署中受益。
summary_cn: 把 SOC 告警分诊形式化为约束决策问题，在 74,909 条生产告警上对比 RL、Isolation Forest 与自编码器：RL 良性升级率最低（0.000），三者覆盖互补。
objective_summary: 将 SOC 告警分诊形式化为容量约束下的决策问题，在 74,909 条生产告警、严格时间切分与良性升级约束下对比强化学习、Isolation Forest 与自编码器三种方法的分诊表现。
evidence_note: 74,909 条分析师标注的生产告警、严格时间切分与良性升级约束下的受控对比，主工作点良性升级率 0.000/0.007/0.041；单一站点数据、簇级排序、无统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 把告警分诊重构为约束决策问题并做三种互补模型族的受控对比，评估框架有诊断价值；三种方法本身均为已有技术。
scope: 生产 SOC 告警分诊；74,909 条单站点标注告警、严格时间切分；评估以告警簇为单位（503 个唯一特征模式）。
limitations: 单一站点单一数据集；测试集仅 503 个唯一特征模式，评估以簇级为主；RL 策略依赖历史标签分布，泛化到新攻击类型未验证。

title: Trinetra.Q: Statistical and Behavioral Detection of Attacks on the Quantum-Error-Correction Layer and Classical Control Stack of Quantum Computing Systems
abstract: Most quantum-computer security work targets physical-layer attacks on qubits, while two surfaces remain inadequately defended: the quantum-error-correction (QEC) syndrome-and-decoder pipeline, and the classical control and software stack that runs it. Tampering on these surfaces can corrupt a computation while the physical error rate appears normal, and can stay within a single-circuit integrity tolerance. We present Trinetra.Q, a detection layer of cooperating detectors, each monitoring a statistical or behavioral property of quantum-domain data against an envelope calibrated from honest operation, and raising an indication only on a statistically significant deviation. The detectors cover (A) QEC integrity over per-stabilizer firing rates, syndrome defect-count, and repeated-syndrome rate; (B) decoder confidence over the margin between minimum-weight error explanations in distinct logical classes; (C) behavioral output divergence, flagging crosstalk-class and novel attacks by their effect on a victim's output relative to a matched control; (D) control-stack tampering via known-answer canary circuits, built to be indistinguishable to a resident implant, with a cross-job consistency statistic; and (E) compilation/execution integrity. Each gates on significance, so honest operation raises no alarm. We evaluate in faithful simulation and on three production IBM Heron processors, and bound the physical attack surface with a systematic negative map: most physical-layer attacks return statistically null, the exception an implemented, measured within-job feed-forward covert-channel primitive. Every detector is also evaluated against an adaptive attacker with full knowledge of it. To our knowledge this is the first unified statistical-and-behavioral detection layer for the QEC layer and classical control stack of a quantum computing system, demonstrated on production hardware.
title_cn: Trinetra.Q：针对量子纠错层与经典控制栈攻击的统计与行为检测
abstract_cn: 大多数量子计算机安全工作针对量子比特的物理层攻击，而两个层面仍缺乏充分防护：量子纠错（QEC）综合征与解码器管线，以及运行它的经典控制与软件栈。对这些层面的篡改可以在物理错误率看起来正常时破坏计算，并可保持在单电路完整性容差之内。我们提出 Trinetra.Q，一个由协作检测器组成的检测层，每个检测器对照从诚实运行校准的包络监测量子域数据的某一统计或行为性质，只在统计显著偏离时给出指示。检测器覆盖：(A) 基于 per-stabilizer 触发率、综合征缺陷计数与重复综合征率的 QEC 完整性；(B) 基于不同逻辑类中最小权重错误解释之间裕度的解码器置信度；(C) 行为输出分歧，按受害者输出相对匹配对照的影响标记串扰类与新型攻击；(D) 通过已知答案金丝雀电路检测控制栈篡改，这些电路被构造成对驻留植入体不可区分，并配有跨作业一致性统计量；(E) 编译/执行完整性。每个检测器都进行显著性门控，因此诚实运行不会告警。我们在忠真仿真和三台生产级 IBM Heron 处理器上评估，并用系统性负映射界定物理攻击面：大多数物理层攻击在统计上无信号，例外是一个已实现、已测量的作业内前馈隐蔽信道原语。每个检测器还针对完全了解它的自适应攻击者做了评估。据我们所知，这是首个针对量子计算系统 QEC 层与经典控制栈的统一统计与行为检测层，并在生产硬件上得到验证。
summary_cn: Trinetra.Q 用五类协作检测器监控量子纠错管线与经典控制栈的统计/行为偏差，在三台 IBM Heron 生产机评估并对抗自适应攻击者，为该层面首个统一检测层。
objective_summary: 提出面向量子纠错层与经典控制栈的协作检测层 Trinetra.Q，包含 QEC 完整性、解码器置信度、行为分歧、金丝雀电路与编译完整性五类检测器，在仿真与 IBM Heron 生产机上评估并测试自适应攻击者。
evidence_note: 在忠真仿真与三台生产级 IBM Heron 处理器上实测，每个检测器都针对完全了解它的自适应攻击者评估，并用系统性负映射界定物理攻击面，检测器均做显著性门控。
novelty_note: 首个针对 QEC 层与经典控制栈的统一统计与行为检测层，且在生产硬件上验证；填补量子系统安全研究中被忽视的两个防护面。
scope: 量子计算系统的 QEC 层与经典控制栈；在 IBM Heron 生产机与忠真仿真中评估；覆盖 QEC 完整性、解码器、行为、控制栈与编译五类检测。
limitations: 检测包络需按系统诚实运行校准，部署前收集成本高；演示的攻击类型有限（含一个隐蔽信道原语）；行为检测依赖匹配对照。

title: Demystifying Information Flow Downgrading using the Real--Ideal Paradigm
abstract: The real--ideal paradigm, an approach to security specification developed in the cryptography community, has the benefit that it can express sophisticated confidentiality and integrity requirements, even for decentralized systems. We show that this paradigm is the basis for a powerful and intuitive new semantic framework for language-based security. Our new framework cleanly and extensionally captures existing security definitions, including not only noninterference but also less understood information flow properties that involve downgrading, such as robust declassification and nonmalleable information flow. Past semantics for these properties have relied on intensional downgrading events. Further, we show that all of these properties can be enforced by a practical information-flow type system for a while-language that supports downgrading. Surprisingly, correctness of this type system is also characterized as a real--ideal simulation, with an important implication: the security of heterogeneous, decentralized systems with a strong (real) attacker can be understood by reasoning about a weak (ideal) attacker whose power is restricted to interaction with downgrading. This result explains the usefulness of nonmalleable information flow and related security properties. The results are fully formalized using the Rocq prover and are publicly available.
title_cn: 用真实–理想范式解密信息流降级
abstract_cn: 真实–理想（real–ideal）范式是密码学社区发展出的一种安全规范方法，其优点在于能表达复杂的保密性与完整性需求，甚至适用于去中心化系统。我们证明这一范式是语言级安全一个新的强大且直观的语义框架的基础。我们的新框架以外延方式干净地刻画既有安全定义，不仅包括非干扰（noninterference），还包括较不为人理解、涉及信息流降级（downgrading）的性质，如健壮解密级（robust declassification）与不可伪造信息流（nonmalleable information flow）；以往这些性质的语义都依赖内省式的降级事件。此外，我们证明所有这些性质都可以由一个支持降级的 while 语言的实用信息流类型系统强制执行。出人意料的是，该类型系统的正确性本身也可刻画为真实–理想模拟，其重要推论是：具有强（真实）攻击者的异构去中心化系统的安全性，可以通过推理一个其能力被限制为与降级交互的弱（理想）攻击者来理解。这一结果解释了不可伪造信息流及相关安全性质为何有用。所有结果均用 Rocq 证明器完全形式化并已公开。
summary_cn: 以密码学真实–理想范式给语言级安全建立新语义框架，外延刻画非干扰与降级性质（健壮解密级、不可伪造信息流），并用 while 语言类型系统强制执行，Rocq 全形式化。
objective_summary: 以真实–理想范式为语言级安全建立新的外延语义框架，统一刻画非干扰、健壮解密级与不可伪造信息流，给出支持降级的 while 语言类型系统并用 Rocq 完成全形式化。
evidence_note: 语义框架、类型系统正确性与强/弱攻击者推理关系均在 Rocq 证明器中完全形式化，证明完整性高；结果为理论刻画而非实验测量。
novelty_note: 首次以真实–理想范式外延统一刻画降级类信息流性质，摆脱内省式降级事件，并解释不可伪造信息流等性质的可用性；属该方向的系统化新语义框架。
scope: 带降级的 while 语言与语言级信息流安全；去中心化系统的强攻击者推理；结论由 Rocq 全形式化。
limitations: 核心结果在带降级的 while 语言上建立，向实用语言的推广未讨论；类型系统在真实规模代码库上的可用性未评估。

title: AQUA - A Modular Authentication Quality Modeling Framework
abstract: Authentication solutions are the key design, architectural, and implementation decisions that implement authentication security controls. An example is a password-based authentication solution. While researchers often examine authentication quality, existing approaches do not distinguish which effects on quality stem from which aspect of authentication. For example, multi-factor authentication solutions tend to be less usable because they combine multiple authenticators, whereas passkeys are more secure than passwords because of properties inherent to the authenticator itself. This paper presents AQUA, a modular quality modeling framework for authentication solutions. AQUA's core idea is to decompose authentication into four interrelated concepts, enabling modular specification of authentication quality and tracing quality effects back to their source. We demonstrate AQUA with initial definitional quality models that address the levels of authenticators, authentication techniques, and authentication solutions. We further illustrate the interrelations between these concepts through concrete examples and a usability metric, showing how quality propagates across the concepts and ultimately affects the overall quality of an authentication solution. Our results provide a foundation for future work, including designing assessment and prediction models for authentication solutions and automated quality assessments.
title_cn: AQUA：模块化认证质量建模框架
abstract_cn: 认证解决方案是落实认证安全控制的设计、架构与实现决策的总和，例如基于口令的认证方案。虽然研究者经常考察认证质量，但现有方法无法区分质量影响来自认证的哪个方面。例如，多因素认证方案往往因组合多个认证器而可用性较差，而 passkey 比口令更安全是因为认证器自身的固有性质。本文提出 AQUA，一个面向认证解决方案的模块化质量建模框架。AQUA 的核心思想是把认证分解为四个相互关联的概念，从而支持模块化的质量规范，并把质量影响追溯到其来源。我们用初步的定义性质量模型展示 AQUA，涵盖认证器、认证技术与认证解决方案三个层级；并通过具体示例和一个可用性指标进一步说明这些概念之间的相互关系，展示质量如何在各概念间传播并最终影响认证解决方案的整体质量。我们的结果为未来工作奠定基础，包括为认证解决方案设计评估与预测模型以及自动化质量评估。
summary_cn: 提出 AQUA 模块化认证质量建模框架，把认证分解为四个互相关概念，使质量影响可追溯到认证器、技术与解决方案层级并跨层传播。
objective_summary: 提出模块化认证质量建模框架 AQUA，把认证分解为四个互相关概念并给出认证器、认证技术与认证解决方案三级定义性质量模型，用示例与可用性指标说明质量跨层传播。
evidence_note: 以定义性质量模型、具体示例和一个可用性指标进行概念演示；框架的预测与评估能力未经经验数据验证。
novelty_note: 把认证分解为可追溯质量来源的四个互相关概念，相对整体式考察是新的建模角度；尚未形成可复用的自动化评估。
scope: 认证解决方案（认证器/认证技术/认证解决方案三级）的质量建模；以定义性模型与示例论证，未含自动化评估。
limitations: 质量模型停留在定义性层面，未经经验效度检验；尚未构建评估与预测模型或自动化质量评估；可用性论证基于示例与单一指标。

title: Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization for Autonomous AI Agents
abstract: Autonomous software agents can act through tools, delegate work, and change their models or execution environments while earlier authorizations remain in flight. We present Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization (ACCA), an approach designed to be harness-independent, for maintaining operational authority according to currently justified assurance. It distinguishes evidence validity from contextual applicability, derives assurance claims from eligible evidence, and resolves a multidimensional effective-authority envelope within a principal-declared ceiling and applicable policy. A typed dependency graph supports selective re-evaluation of authorization-relevant changes. An authority epoch changes when effective authority changes; a distinct optional authorization-basis version supports revalidation of action-specific authorization conditions. Protected effect-time enforcement can reject stale actions before a consequential resource change, subject to the available commit mechanism. A compositional Domain Governance Profile expresses domain-specific semantics without granting authority. Controlled scenario tests implemented as a regression suite using a trading profile exercise default-deny rules, evidence-conditioned contraction and recovery, policy divergence, selective non-response, and stale-action rejection at a local gateway before the simulated-broker boundary. The study establishes implementation-level evidence in one domain, not a cross-domain guarantee of harmful-behavior prevention.
title_cn: 面向自主 AI 智能体的保证条件化持续授权
abstract_cn: 自主软件智能体可以通过工具执行操作、委派工作，并在先前的授权仍在生效时更改其模型或执行环境。我们提出保证条件化持续授权（Assurance-Conditioned Continuous Authorization，ACCA），一种设计为与 harness 无关的方法，用于依据当前有依据的保证来维持操作权限。它区分证据有效性与情境适用性，从合格证据导出保证声明，并在主体声明的上限与适用策略之内解析多维有效权限包络。一个类型化依赖图支持对与授权相关的变更进行选择性重评估。当有效权限变化时，权限纪元（authority epoch）随之变更；另一个可选的授权基准版本支持对动作特定授权条件的重新验证。受保护的效果时点强制执行可在重大资源变更前拒绝过期动作，取决于可用的提交机制。组合式的域治理档案（Domain Governance Profile）在不授予权限的情况下表达领域特定语义。以某交易档案实现的受控场景测试（回归套件）演练了默认拒绝规则、证据条件化的权限收缩与恢复、策略分歧、选择性不应答以及在模拟券商边界之前的本地网关处拒绝过期动作。该研究在单一领域建立了实现层面的证据，并非跨领域的有害行为预防保证。
summary_cn: 提出 ACCA 持续授权框架：按当前保证动态解析有效权限包络，权限纪元与效果时点强制执行拒绝过期动作，交易域回归套件验证默认拒绝与收缩恢复。
objective_summary: 提出保证条件化持续授权框架 ACCA，以证据有效性、类型化依赖图、权限纪元与效果时点强制执行维护自主智能体的动态授权，并用交易域回归套件做受控场景测试。
evidence_note: 以交易档案实现的受控场景回归测试套件演练默认拒绝、收缩恢复、策略分歧、不应答与拒绝过期动作等情形；81 页设计文档，无跨域或对抗性实验。
novelty_note: 针对授权随环境漂移的问题提出持续、保证条件化的授权维护框架，纪元、依赖图与效果时点强制的组合在智能体治理方向较新。
scope: 自主智能体的持续授权与治理；验证限于单一交易域受控场景回归套件；效果时点强制执行依赖可用提交机制。
limitations: 作者自陈仅在单一交易域建立实现层面证据，不构成跨领域有害行为预防保证；效果时点强制执行受提交机制限制；无对抗性评估。

title: Exploring the Privacy--Size Tradeoff for Differentially Private Self-Attentive Variational Autoencoders
abstract: Data tends to be most useful when it is shared, and the data most worth sharing is often the data that privacy obligations restrict. Synthetic data from a generator trained under differential privacy (DP) is one way to reconcile the two, but its utility depends on the privacy budget $\varepsilon$ and on how much data the generator sees - a parameter that most data sharing applications of synthetic data control. We present SAVANT, a self-attentive variational autoencoder for tabular data trained with DP-SGD that, to our knowledge, is the first to combine attention, a VAE, and DP in one tabular model. We evaluate it against two marginal mechanisms, PrivBayes and MST, jointly over the privacy budget and the dataset size on two public datasets, measuring the utility a downstream classifier loses by training on synthetic rather than real data. We find that, under the same DP guarantee, more data generally means more utility. For the marginal mechanisms it absorbs most of what a strict budget costs, and a noise-scaling argument suggests DP-SGD exchanges data fo budget at a worse rate. Two independent membership-inference attacks, judged against a measured null, found no aggregate membership signal.
comment: ICAIF 2026, Financial AI Security, Privacy and Safety workshop. Poster session
title_cn: 探索差分隐私自注意力变分自编码器的隐私–数据规模权衡
abstract_cn: 数据在被共享时最有用，而最值得共享的数据往往正是隐私义务所限制的数据。在差分隐私（DP）下训练的生成器产生的合成数据是调和二者的一种方式，但其效用取决于隐私预算 ε 以及生成器能看见多少数据——这是大多数合成数据共享应用都会控制的一个参数。我们提出 SAVANT，一个用 DP-SGD 训练的自注意力变分自编码器，用于表格数据；据我们所知，它是首个把注意力、VAE 与 DP 结合在单一表格模型中的工作。我们在两个公开数据集上、在隐私预算与数据集规模两个维度联合评估它与两个边际机制 PrivBayes 和 MST，度量下游分类器因用合成数据而非真实数据训练所损失的效用。我们发现，在相同 DP 保证下，更多的数据通常意味着更高的效用；对边际机制而言，数据吸收了严格预算的大部分代价，而一个噪声缩放论证表明 DP-SGD 以更差的比率用数据换预算。两个独立的成员推断攻击在对照实测零假设的判定下未发现总体成员信号。
summary_cn: 提出 SAVANT：DP-SGD 训练的自注意力 VAE 表格合成模型；同隐私下数据越多效用越高，边际机制可用数据弥补严格预算，两种成员攻击未发现总体泄漏。
objective_summary: 提出 DP-SGD 训练的自注意力变分自编码器 SAVANT，在隐私预算与数据集规模两个维度上与 PrivBayes、MST 对比表格合成数据效用，并用两个成员推断攻击检验隐私。
evidence_note: 在两个公开数据集上与 PrivBayes、MST 系统对比并报告下游分类器效用损失，两个成员推断攻击对照实测零假设；规模有限、无统计显著性检验。
novelty_note: 首次把注意力、VAE 与 DP-SGD 组合到单一表格生成模型；隐私–数据规模权衡的量化对比有诊断价值，组件本身均为已有技术。
scope: 表格数据的 DP 合成发布；结论基于两个公开数据集与两个边际机制对比，效用以下游分类器度量。
limitations: 仅两个公开数据集；效用只以下游分类器度量；DP-SGD 换算更差率的论断依赖噪声缩放论证而非实验证明。

title: Optimal Marginal Mixing for Transvection-Based Trapdoored Matrices over Large Fields
abstract: \emph{Trapdoored matrices} are pseudorandom matrices admitting a fast matrix-vector multiplication algorithm given the secret key. We study a candidate family of such matrices: matrices generated by short random \emph{transvection walks} on \(\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{F}_q)\), whose steps are given by adding a random multiple of a random row of the current state to another. We show that the worst-case time for any nonempty set \(\mathcal{S}\subseteq [n]\times[n]\) of matrix entries to come within TV distance \(\varepsilon\leq \frac{1}{4}\) of its stationary marginal under this walk is \(\Theta(|\mathcal{S}|+n\log(n/\varepsilon))\), uniformly over all \(\mathcal{S}\) and \(q\geq Q_\mathrm{all}(n)\). This is asymptotically optimal, and resolves open questions about the mixing times of transvection walks. We derive concrete upper and lower bounds for \(n\geq 256\). Surprisingly, our bounds also hold conditioned on the row-pair structure of the walk, except on a fraction at most \(\varepsilon\) of such structures. This implies that these walks may be pseudorandom even after conditioning on the row-pair structure, and therefore that trapdoored matrices built with these walks may be universal. Assuming the conjectured structure-conditioned pseudorandomness of short walks, we exhibit highly efficient, highly parallelizable, and universal trapdoored matrices over \(\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{F}_q)\), \(\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{F}_q)\), and \(\mathbb{F}_q^{n\times n}\). The families over \(\mathrm{SL}_n(\mathbb{F}_q)\) and \(\mathrm{GL}_n(\mathbb{F}_q)\) admit equally efficient trapdoors for their inverses, making them the first to do so for finite-field trapdoored matrices. We discuss attacks, analyzing one in detail, and lay out directions for further investigation.
title_cn: 大域上基于平延的陷门矩阵的最优边际混合时间
abstract_cn: 陷门矩阵（trapdoored matrices）是伪随机矩阵，在给定密钥时允许快速矩阵–向量乘法算法。我们研究此类矩阵的一个候选族：由 SL_n(F_q) 上短随机平延（transvection）游走生成的矩阵，其每一步是把当前状态某一随机行的随机倍数加到另一行上。我们证明，在该游走下，任意非空矩阵元素集合 S⊆[n]×[n] 与其平稳边际的 TV 距离在 ε≤1/4 内达到的最坏情形时间为 Θ(|S|+n·log(n/ε))，对所有 S 和 q≥Q_all(n) 一致成立。这是渐近最优的，并解决了关于平延随机游走混合时间的开放问题。我们对 n≥256 推导了具体的上界与下界。出人意料的是，除至多 ε 比例的行对结构外，这些界在以游走的行对结构为条件时仍然成立。这意味着这些游走在以行对结构为条件后仍可能是伪随机的，因此用这些游走构造的陷门矩阵可能是通用的（universal）。在猜测的结构条件化伪随机性假设下，我们给出 SL_n(F_q)、GL_n(F_q) 与 F_q^{n×n} 上高效、高度可并行且通用的陷门矩阵。SL_n(F_q) 与 GL_n(F_q) 上的族对其逆矩阵同样具有高效陷门，使其成为有限域陷门矩阵中首个具备该性质的构造。我们讨论了攻击，详细分析其中一种，并为进一步研究指出方向。
summary_cn: 证明平延随机游走生成矩阵的边际混合时间为 Θ(|S|+n·log(n/ε))，渐近最优并解决开放问题，据此给出首个带高效逆陷门的有限域陷门矩阵族。
objective_summary: 对 SL_n(F_q) 上短平延随机游走证明任意元素集合边际混合时间的最坏情形紧界 Θ(|S|+n·log(n/ε))，并在结构条件化伪随机性猜想下构造通用且支持高效逆陷门的陷门矩阵族。
evidence_note: 主定理为完整证明的渐近最优（紧）混合时间界，解决既有开放问题，并对 n≥256 给出具体上/下界与一种攻击的详细分析；应用部分依赖明确标注的猜想。
novelty_note: 首个渐近最优的平延游走边际混合结果；有限域陷门矩阵中首个对逆矩阵同样具备高效陷门的构造。
scope: 大域（q≥Q_all(n)）上基于短平延游走的陷门矩阵；具体界针对 n≥256；通用性与高效逆陷门依赖结构条件化伪随机性猜想。
limitations: 陷门矩阵的通用性与高效逆陷门依赖尚未证明的结构条件化伪随机性猜想；具体界限于 n≥256；攻击分析仅详细覆盖一种。

title: From Claws to Conferences: Device-Independent Key Agreement Beyond Non-Signaling
abstract: Device-independent conference key agreement (DI-CKA) allows a group of users to establish a common secret key without trusting the internal operation of their quantum devices. Existing DI-CKA protocols derive their security from multipartite Bell tests and therefore require the device components not to communicate during each round. We present, to the best of our knowledge, the first DI-CKA protocol that removes this non-signaling assumption: all interfaces and their mutual communication are treated as one untrusted device, which only has to be quantum polynomial-time while the protocol runs. Assuming that the Learning With Errors (LWE) problem is hard for quantum algorithms with quantum advice during the execution, we prove finite-size security against coherent attacks, in which the device may keep quantum memory and correlate and adapt its behavior across rounds. For two parties the protocol is a computational DI-QKD protocol with an explicit finite-size proof against coherent attacks. Technically, we lift the claw state underlying the classical-verifier test of Brakerski et al.\ (FOCS 2018) to multipartite entanglement, obtaining a \emph{GHZ-correlated claw state}. %that is prepared with one coherent claw-free function evaluation and $N-1$ CNOT gates. We then introduce the \emph{collective adaptive hardcore bit}, a multiparty generalization of the adaptive hardcore bit of Brakerski et al.\ and show that it follows from the original property by a tight reduction. Combined with Jordan's lemma, an entropic uncertainty relation, and entropy accumulation, this certifies smooth min-entropy of the key against an external quantum adversary. Our protocol achieves \emph{everlasting security}: LWE needs to hold only during the execution, because the final key is statistically secure and its secrecy persists even if LWE is broken after the protocol ends.
title_cn: 从爪态到多方会议：超越无通信假设的设备无关密钥协商
abstract_cn: 设备无关会议密钥协商（DI-CKA）允许一组用户在不信任其量子设备内部运作的情况下建立共享密钥。现有 DI-CKA 协议的安全性来自多方贝尔测试，因此要求设备组件在每轮期间不得相互通信。据我们所知，我们提出首个移除这一无通信（non-signaling）假设的 DI-CKA 协议：所有接口及其相互通信被视为一个不受信任的设备，只需在协议运行期间是量子多项式时间的。假设 Learning With Errors（LWE）问题在执行期间对带量子建议（quantum advice）的量子算法是困难的，我们证明了针对相干攻击的有限尺寸安全性，其中设备可以保留量子记忆并在轮次之间关联和调整其行为。对两方情形，该协议是一个计算性 DI-QKD 协议，带有针对相干攻击的显式有限尺寸证明。在技术上，我们将 Brakerski 等人（FOCS 2018）经典验证者测试所用的爪态（claw state）提升为多方纠缠，得到 GHZ 关联爪态；随后引入集体自适应困难位（collective adaptive hardcore bit），这是 Brakerski 等人自适应困难位的多方推广，并证明它通过紧致归约可由原性质推出。结合 Jordan 引理、熵不确定性关系与熵累积，这证明了对正确性受外部量子对手影响的密钥的平滑最小熵。我们的协议实现持久安全（everlasting security）：LWE 只需在执行期间成立，因为最终密钥是统计安全的，即使 LWE 在协议结束后被破解其保密性仍然保持。
summary_cn: 首个移除非通信假设的设备无关会议密钥协商协议：以 GHZ 关联爪态与集体自适应困难位证明对相干攻击的有限尺寸安全，并获持久安全。
objective_summary: 提出首个不依赖无通信假设的设备无关会议密钥协商协议，通过 GHZ 关联爪态、集体自适应困难位与熵累积给出对相干攻击的有限尺寸安全证明，并实现持久安全。
evidence_note: 纯理论工作：完整有限尺寸安全证明（相干攻击、熵累积、Jordan 引理、紧致归约的自适应困难位），安全性归约到执行期 LWE 困难性；无实验实现。
novelty_note: 首个移除核心非通信假设的 DI-CKA/DI-QKD 协议，提出 GHZ 关联爪态与集体自适应困难位两个新原语，开辟设备无关密码的新技术路线。
scope: 设备无关量子密钥协商/会议密钥协商；安全性依赖执行期内 LWE 对带量子建议的量子算法困难；设备在协议运行期为量子多项式时间。
limitations: 安全性为计算性（执行期内 LWE 困难），非信息论安全；协议依赖多方纠缠制备与测量，实验可行性未验证；证明假设设备量子多项式时间。

title: Quantum Advantage has Few Complexity Implications
abstract: We consider the complexity implications of proofs of quantumness and (quantum verifier) oblivious state preparation. We show that both of these objects can coexist with the easiness of nondeterministic computation. That is, we give evidence that proofs of quantumness can exist when $\mathsf{P} = \mathsf{NP}$ and that (quantum verifier) oblivious state preparation can exist when $\mathsf{BQP} = \mathsf{QCMA}$. In particular, we give a classical oracle relative to which (1) $\mathsf{P}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{NP}^\mathcal{O}$ (2) $\mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{PSPACE}^\mathcal{O}$ (3) Proofs of quantumness exist. In particular, there exists a language in $\mathsf{IP}^\mathcal{O} \subseteq \mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O}$ which is hard on average against $\mathsf{P}^\mathcal{O}/poly$. We give a unitary oracle such that (1) $\mathsf{BQP}^\mathcal{O} = \mathsf{QCMA}^\mathcal{O}$ (2) Quantum verifier oblivious state preparation exists. These oracle separations directly imply a number of related consequences. For example, our first result implies that proofs of quantumness cannot be used to construct classical or quantum cryptography with a relativizing proof. Our second result implies that quantum computation/classical communication oblivious transfer cannot be used to construct post-quantum one-way functions with a relativizing proof.
title_cn: 量子优势几乎没有复杂性理论推论
abstract_cn: 我们考虑量子性证明与（量子验证者）遗忘态制备的复杂性含义。我们证明这两类对象都能与非确定性计算的容易性共存：我们给出证据表明，当 P=NP 时量子性证明仍可存在，且（量子验证者）遗忘态制备可在 BQP=QCMA 时存在。具体地，我们给出一个经典 oracle，相对它（1）P^O=NP^O，（2）BQP^O=PSPACE^O，（3）量子性证明存在——特别地，存在一个属于 IP^O⊆BQP^O 的语言，对 P^O/poly 平均困难。我们给出一个酉 oracle，相对它（1）BQP^O=QCMA^O，（2）量子验证者遗忘态制备存在。这些 oracle 分离直接蕴含若干相关结论：例如第一个结果表明，量子性证明不能被相对化证明用于构造经典或量子密码；第二个结果表明，量子计算/经典通信遗忘传输不能被相对化证明用于构造后量子单向函数。
summary_cn: 构造经典与酉 oracle 分离，证明量子性证明可在 P=NP 下存在、遗忘态制备可在 BQP=QCMA 下存在，说明此类量子密码原语的构造无法被相对化证明推广为一般密码学。
objective_summary: 构造相对化世界使非确定性计算塌缩的同时保留量子性证明与遗忘态制备的平均困难性，并推导对相对化证明技术的推论。
evidence_note: 理论论文：给出完整 oracle 构造与证明（经典与酉 oracle），但结论为相对化证据而非无条件定理，复杂度塌缩假设是反事实情形。
novelty_note: 把量子优势的复杂性含义有限这一消息具体化为新的 oracle 分离；构造技术承袭 oracle 分离与平均困难性放大的已有框架。
scope: 结论关于相对化世界与黑盒/相对化证明技术的边界；对具体协议的安全性或非相对化证明不做断言。
limitations: oracle 分离不能排除非相对化构造；酉 oracle 结果的物理可实现性有限；对平均困难语言的具体分布未刻画。

title: Information Loss Is All You Need: $TC^0$ Pseudorandomness from Worst-Case Lattices
abstract: Can deterministic information loss yield post-quantum pseudorandomness with $TC^0$ evaluation? We show that deterministic rounding achieves this under quantum worst-case lattice hardness, with fixed polynomial parameters and no predetermined sample bound. We introduce learning with algebraic rounding (LAR), which applies an explicit integer rounding map to blocks of secret-dependent linear measurements and encodes the result in a lattice quotient. For one fixed family with polynomially bounded modulus and dimensions, deterministic labels on exactly uniform, secret-independent public matrices are computationally indistinguishable from independent uniform labels for every polynomial number of classical random examples. Our classical reduction from Gaussian LWE, combined with the quantum worst-case reduction to LWE, bases LAR on GapSVP and SIVP over general lattices at approximation factor $\widetilde{O}(q)$, where $q$ is the modulus. The proof uses source-independent affine transport: public affine maps sampled independently of the hidden errors transport the Gaussian error law close to uniform on the rounding map's zero-label fiber while preserving exactly uniform public matrices. For every fixed inverse-polynomial accuracy, we give a polynomial-time sampler for the same public parameter family. This yields the first post-quantum weak pseudorandom function with joint key-and-input evaluation in $TC^0$, secure against uniform quantum polynomial-time distinguishers given any polynomial number of classical uniform random examples. We also prove hardness of learning polynomial-size two-hidden-layer ReLU networks from noiseless uniform random examples, even for quantum polynomial-time improper learners.
title_cn: 信息损失足矣：源自最坏情况格难题的 TC⁰ 伪随机性
abstract_cn: 确定性信息损失能否在 TC^0 求值下产生后量子伪随机性？我们证明：在量子最坏情况格难题假设下，确定性取整可以做到这一点，参数为固定多项式且无预定样本上限。我们提出学习与代数取整（LAR），对秘密相关的线性测量块应用显式整数取整映射，并把结果编码进格商。对一个固定的、模数与维度多项式有界的族，确定性标签在精确均匀、与秘密无关的公开矩阵上，与独立均匀标签对任意多项式数量的经典随机样本计算不可区分。我们从高斯 LWE 的经典归约，结合到 LWE 的量子最坏情况归约，把 LAR 的安全性建立在一般格上近似因子 O~(q) 的 GapSVP 与 SIVP 上。证明使用来源无关仿射输运：与隐藏误差独立采样的公开仿射映射，把高斯误差律输运到接近取整映射零标签纤维上的均匀分布，同时保持公开矩阵精确均匀。对每个固定的逆多项式精度，我们给出同一公开参数族的多项式时间采样器。这产生了首个后量子弱伪随机函数，其联合密钥-输入求值在 TC^0 中，对给定任意多项式数量经典均匀随机样本的一致量子多项式时间区分者安全。我们还证明从无噪声均匀随机样本学习多项式规模双隐层 ReLU 网络是困难的，即使对量子多项式时间非正常学习器。
summary_cn: 提出 LAR（线性测量加显式取整编码进格商）：在 GapSVP/SIVP 量子最坏情况归约下得到首个 TC⁰ 可求值的后量子弱 PRF，抗量子区分者的任意多项次查询；并证明双隐层 ReLU 网络对量子学习器的不可学习性。
objective_summary: 定义学习与代数取整（LAR）构造，证明其标签与均匀分布的计算不可区分性及基于格最坏情况难题的量子归约，给出采样器与 TC^0 弱 PRF 及 ReLU 网络学习困难性两个推论。
evidence_note: 理论论文：完整归约证明（经典加量子最坏情况到 GapSVP/SIVP，近似 O~(q)）、显式构造与采样器，达到首个 TC^0 后量子弱 PRF 这一此前未达目标。
novelty_note: 首个 TC^0 可求值、抗量子区分者的弱 PRF，确立确定性取整即信息损失的构造路线；归约技术与 LWE 基础承袭已有格密码工作。
scope: 结论为渐近理论（弱 PRF、多项式有界参数族）；不直接给出工程可用 PRF 参数；ReLU 学习困难性为最坏情况陈述。
limitations: 弱 PRF 仅在均匀输入上安全，不满足强 PRF 语义；TC^0 电路深度与大小常数未优化；归约的近似因子较宽松。

title: The Power of Interaction in Locally Edge-Private Subgraph Counting
abstract: We study (non-induced) subgraph counting under interactive local edge differential privacy (LEDP). Given a fixed pattern graph $H$ with $k$ vertices, $\ell\ge1$ edges, and $q$ connected components, our goal is to approximately count its copies in an arbitrary $n$-vertex undirected graph while preserving edge privacy. We give two complementary accuracy guarantees. First, for every $H$, we give Linear Noise Cancellation (LNC), a two-round $\varepsilon$-LEDP algorithm with additive error and root mean square error both $O(n^{k-3/2}/\varepsilon^\ell)$ on every $n$-vertex graph. For fixed sufficiently small $\varepsilon$, this improves the optimal noninteractive additive error for triangles by a factor of $\sqrt n$ and gives the same improvement in worst-case root mean square error for all cliques on at least three vertices. To our knowledge, this is the first separation between interactive and noninteractive LEDP subgraph counting, showing that a single additional round can improve worst-case accuracy polynomially. Second, we determine how accuracy improves when the graph has maximum degree at most a public bound $d$. Our Predict and Correct (PC) framework gives an $(\ell+2)$-round $\varepsilon$-LEDP algorithm with additive error $O(n^{q-1/2}d^{k-q-1}\log^{3\ell-2}n/\varepsilon^\ell)$. For connected patterns, its polynomial factor is $\sqrt n\,d^{k-2}$, giving sublinear error on constant-degree graphs at fixed privacy. We prove matching lower bounds in $n$ and $d$, up to logarithmic factors at fixed privacy, even under arbitrary interaction and approximate privacy with sufficiently small $\delta$. At $d=\Theta(n)$, the lower bound also establishes the optimality of LNC's dependence on $n$.
title_cn: 交互在局部边隐私子图计数中的力量
abstract_cn: 我们研究交互式局部边差分隐私（LEDP）下的非导出子图计数。给定固定模式图 H（k 个顶点、ℓ≥1 条边、q 个连通分量），目标是在任意 n 顶点无向图上近似计数其副本，同时保护边隐私。我们给出两个互补的精度保证。第一，对每个 H，我们给出线性噪声消除（LNC），一个两轮 ε-LEDP 算法，加性误差与均方根误差在所有 n 顶点图上均为 O(n^{k−3/2}/ε^ℓ)。对固定足够小的 ε，这把三角形的最优非交互加性误差改进 √n 倍，并对所有至少三顶点的团在最坏情况均方根误差上给出同样改进。据我们所知，这是交互式与非交互式 LEDP 子图计数之间的首个分离，表明单加一轮即可多项式级改进最坏情况精度。第二，我们确定图最大度不超过公开界 d 时精度如何改进。我们的 Predict and Correct（PC）框架给出 (ℓ+2) 轮 ε-LEDP 算法，加性误差 O(n^{q−1/2}·d^{k−q−1}·log^{3ℓ−2}n/ε^ℓ)。对连通模式，其多项式因子为 √n·d^{k−2}，在固定隐私下常数度图上给出亚线性误差。我们在 n 与 d 上证明匹配下界（固定隐私下至多差对数因子），即使允许任意交互、近似隐私且 δ 足够小。在 d=Θ(n) 时，下界还确立了 LNC 对 n 的依赖的最优性。
summary_cn: 证明交互式 LEDP 子图计数严格强于非交互：两轮 LNC 算法把三角形最坏情况误差改进 √n 倍，度受界图上 PC 框架达亚线性误差，并给出 n 与 d 上的匹配下界——首个交互/非交互分离。
objective_summary: 设计两轮 LNC 与 (ℓ+2) 轮 PC 两类 ε-LEDP 子图计数算法，给出误差上界并证明 n 与 d 上的匹配下界，确立交互性带来的多项式分离。
evidence_note: 理论论文：上界算法加 n 与 d 上匹配下界（至多差对数因子，覆盖任意交互与近似 DP），分离结果完整；64 页含完整证明。
novelty_note: 首次证明交互性在 LEDP 子图计数上的多项式分离，回答交互价值这一基础问题；LNC 噪声消除与 predict-and-correct 技术承袭分布式估计与 DP 计数传统。
scope: 适用于边级局部 DP 的图统计任务；误差为渐近界，常数与实际部署精度未评估；下界依赖近似 DP 与 δ 上限条件。
limitations: 轮次随模式边数增长（ℓ+2）；仅处理计数类查询；实际系统中的通信与信任假设未讨论。

title: Residual Attribute Leakage Is an Interface: Auditing Privacy Evaluation After Text De-identification
abstract: A privacy evaluation of de-identified text asks a language model (the adversary) to guess a person's protected attribute. We introduce a prior-normalised clipped leakage score of its confidence gain on the true value and audit the conclusions drawn from it. Each verdict depends on an evaluation interface (the queried person, answer options, prior, adversary model and scoring rule), which we vary on fixed releases of three corpora. In a stress test, an editor that writes the opposite-sex form at the same spans a redaction editor would redact misleads the adversary about most people, yet ranks first among editors scored on the same MedQA entries under this score, as under attack accuracy and proper scoring rules read as privacy. A relabelling-invariant reading of AUC ranks that editor sixth of eight, and a rule-aware adversary recovers the attribute from the same text. On ordinary releases most verdict changes are gains or losses of separability; of six choices varied over all pairs, only the adversary reverses comparisons (5 of its 124 changes), and the query can target the wrong person. SACC, a traceable editor we build as the instrument, lets us ablate two editing principles and show where its advantage does not hold.
title_cn: 残余属性泄漏是一个接口问题：文本去标识化后隐私评估的审计
abstract_cn: 对去标识化文本的隐私评估，通常让一个语言模型（作为对手）猜测某人的受保护属性。我们引入对其真实值置信度增益的先验归一化截断泄漏分数，并审计由它得出的结论。每个结论都依赖于一个评估接口——被查询的人、答案选项、先验、对手模型与打分规则——我们在三个语料的固定发布版上变化这些接口。在压力测试中，一个在与删除式编辑器相同的文本位置写入异性形式的编辑器会误导对手对大多数人的判断，却在同一 MedQA 条目上按该分数排名第一，与按攻击准确率及按读作隐私的适当评分规则的结果一致。AUC 的重标记不变解读把该编辑器排到八分之六，而规则感知的对手能从同一文本恢复属性。在普通发布版上，多数结论变化是可分离性的得失；在被变化的六个选择的全部两两对比中，只有对手模型逆转比较（124 次变化中的 5 次），且查询可能指向错误的人。我们构建的、作为研究工具的可追溯编辑器 SACC 让我们消融两条编辑原则并展示其优势失效之处。
summary_cn: 提出先验归一化截断泄漏分数并审计去标识化隐私评估的接口敏感性：换打分规则或对手即可逆转编辑器排名（同一 MedQA 上误导性编辑器排第一），AUC 重标记不变解读排第六，隐私结论依赖接口选择。
objective_summary: 定义先验归一化的属性泄漏分数，在固定语料发布版上变化被查询人、答案选项、先验、对手模型与打分规则并审计排名翻转，构建可追溯编辑器 SACC 消融编辑原则。
evidence_note: 三个语料固定发布版、多类接口两两变化的系统审计（124 次比较变化），含压力测试与消融；编辑器与对手自建，无外部验证或统计检验。
novelty_note: 把泄漏结论依赖评估接口作为可测量对象并给出标准化分数，属评估方法学修正；去标识化泄漏攻击与 LLM 对手设定承袭已有工作。
scope: 适用于文本去标识化的隐私评估设计与报告；结论限于三个英文医疗/问答类语料与所选编辑器族，对图像或多模态去标识化不适用。
limitations: 分数对先验与选项集设定敏感（这正是其论点）；编辑器评估受 MedQA 条目分布影响；未给出推荐评估协议的最终规范。

title: Leakage-Resilient Computation via Matrix Refreshing
abstract: Leakage-resilient cryptography protects secrets against side-channel attacks, in which a physical implementation reveals partial information about its internal state. A fundamental primitive in this area is a leakage-resilient storage, which allows a secret to be stored in a way that remains secure even if an adversary learns some information about the storage's internal state. A popular approach represents a secret as the inner product of two $n$-bit vectors, called shares. The shares are stored and processed separately by two parts of the implementation, called the left and right parties. Because leakage accumulates over time, the shares must be refreshed repeatedly. We prove that a simple refresh, in which the left party multiplies its share by a uniform invertible matrix $M$ and the right party multiplies its share by $M^{-1}$, is secure under continual local leakage. After $T$ refreshes, each allowing at most $\lambda$ bits of leakage per party, the transcripts for two stored secrets are at statistical distance at most $C\cdot T\cdot 2^{6\lambda-n/9}$ for an absolute constant $C$. We also obtain a Boolean-circuit compiler with statistical privacy error at most $C\cdot S\cdot 2^{18\lambda-n/27}$ for $S$ operations and at most $\lambda$ bits of local leakage per party per operation. The guarantee covers repeated stateful evaluations with adaptively chosen public inputs, with $S$ counting all operations across invocations. Thus, for polynomial-size circuits, a constant leakage fraction is tolerated with share length depending only on the security parameter. We formalize the refreshing bound, the composition and compiler guarantees, and the expected-work bounds in Lean 4. Our results also provide efficient simulation: the leakage can be reproduced from the public inputs and the circuit outputs alone, with expected polynomial overhead.
title_cn: 经由矩阵刷新的抗泄漏计算
abstract_cn: 抗泄漏密码学保护秘密免受侧信道攻击——物理实现会泄露内部状态的部分信息。该领域的基本原语之一是抗泄漏存储：即使对手获知存储内部状态的部分信息，秘密仍保持安全。一种流行做法把秘密表示为两个 n 比特向量的内积，称为份额，由实现的左右两方分开存储与处理。由于泄漏随时间累积，份额必须反复刷新。我们证明一个简单刷新——左方用均匀可逆矩阵 M 乘其份额、右方用 M^{-1} 乘其份额——在持续局部泄漏下是安全的。T 次刷新后（每次允许每方至多 λ 比特泄漏），两个所存秘密的转录本统计距离至多 C·T·2^{6λ−n/9}，C 为绝对常数。我们还得到一个布尔电路编译器，对 S 次操作、每方每次操作 λ 比特局部泄漏，统计隐私误差至多 C·S·2^{18λ−n/27}。该保证覆盖自适应选择公开输入的重复有状态求值，S 计入跨调用的所有操作。因此对多项式规模电路，可容忍常数比例泄漏且份额长度只依赖安全参数。我们把刷新界、组合与编译器保证及期望工作界形式化于 Lean 4。结果还提供高效模拟：泄漏可以仅由公开输入与电路输出复现，期望开销为多项式。
summary_cn: 证明左右份额乘 M/M^{-1} 的简单刷新在持续局部泄漏下安全：T 次刷新后统计距离 ≤C·T·2^(6λ−n/9)，并给出电路编译器界与 Lean 4 形式化；多项式规模电路可容忍常数比例泄漏。
objective_summary: 证明矩阵乘法式份额刷新在持续局部泄漏模型下的安全性并推导转录距离界，构造布尔电路编译器与组合保证，在 Lean 4 中形式化全部证明并给出高效模拟。
evidence_note: 理论论文：完整安全性证明加 Lean 4 机器校验的形式化与高效模拟构造，参数达到实用区间（多项式电路容忍常数比例泄漏）。
novelty_note: 证明极简矩阵刷新在持续局部泄漏下安全，是该模型的实质简化进展；内积份额与局部泄漏模型承袭已有抗泄漏存储工作。
scope: 结论适用于以内积分享存储、局部泄漏上限 λ 的实现模型；不覆盖全局或计算性泄漏与物理实现的具体泄漏分布。
limitations: 界中的指数因子要求份额长度随 λ 与参数增长；编译器针对布尔电路，算术电路优化未涉及；期望多项式开销的常数未评估。

title: Extracting System Prompt of LLM Services in Complex (Agentic) Settings: Hierarchical Optimization and Reliable Evaluation Metrics
abstract: System prompt is a critical intellectual property of large language model (LLM) services. To analyze its leakage, prompt extraction attacks have been extensively studied. However, we validate that existing attacks substantially degrade on recent LLM services, whose complexity has evolved in both the prompt itself and system-level constraints. Specifically, (1) system prompts become longer and more structured to contain pre-defined tool schemas, execution logic, safety guardrails, etc., and (2) only the final post-processed outputs (e.g., agent's actions) but not the raw textual response can be observed. In this paper, we address the above increased complexity by proposing Extraction with Hierarchical Optimization (ExtraHerO), which (1) decomposes the prompt extraction into a hierarchical reconstruction process with a pre-defined structural prompt template, and (2) iteratively updates the adversarial query with guidance of feedback-template differences to observe diverse outputs. In particular, we monitor the information gain of attack optimization to early stop or reset it for a good trade-off between effectiveness and efficiency. We also find that existing evaluation metrics for prompt fidelity can be misleading because they do not account for structural information. Therefore, we rely on global textual similarity and prioritize structural keywords. Moreover, we introduce a system-level metric, adversarial utility, to measure the help of prompt extraction for real-world downstream attacks. Experimental results demonstrate the consistent superiority of ExtraHerO, with average improvements of 12.5\% (fidelity), 2.3\% (functionality), and 6.0\% (adversarial utility) on chatbots, and 12.2\%, 34.3\%, and 30.5\% on agents.
title_cn: 在复杂（智能体）场景下提取 LLM 服务的系统提示词：分层优化与可靠评估指标
abstract_cn: 系统提示词是 LLM 服务的关键知识产权。为分析其泄漏，提示词提取攻击已被广泛研究。但我们验证发现，现有攻击在近期 LLM 服务上大幅退化，其复杂性在提示词本身与系统级约束两方面都有演化：（1）系统提示词变得更长、更结构化，以包含预定义工具 schema、执行逻辑与安全护栏等；（2）只能观察最终后处理输出（如智能体动作）而非原始文本响应。针对上述复杂度，我们提出 Extraction with Hierarchical Optimization（ExtraHerO）：（1）把提示词提取分解为带预定义结构化提示模板的分层重构过程；（2）以反馈模板差异为指导迭代更新对抗查询以观察多样输出。特别地，我们监控攻击优化的信息增益，以及时停止或重置，在有效性与效率间取得好的折衷。我们还发现现有的提示保真度评估指标可能误导，因为它们不计结构信息，因此我们依赖全局文本相似性并优先考虑结构关键词；并引入系统级指标对抗效用来衡量提示提取对真实下游攻击的帮助。实验结果表明 ExtraHerO 持续占优：在聊天机器人上保真度、功能性与对抗效用平均提升 12.5%、2.3% 与 6.0%，在智能体上提升 12.2%、34.3% 与 30.5%。
summary_cn: 针对结构化长系统提示与只可见后处理输出的新提取难点，提出分层重构框架 ExtraHerO 与结构感知指标：聊天机器人上保真度 +12.5%，智能体上功能性 +34.3%、对抗效用 +30.5%。
objective_summary: 诊断现有提示提取攻击在结构化智能体服务上的退化，提出分层重构与信息增益引导的查询优化方法及考虑结构的评估指标，在聊天机器人与智能体服务上量化保真度、功能性与对抗效用改进。
evidence_note: 聊天机器人与智能体两类服务上的三指标对比（12.5%/2.3%/6.0% 与 12.2%/34.3%/30.5%），含信息增益早停机制；服务与提示词样本自建，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首次系统处理结构化长提示加仅后处理输出可见的提取场景并给出结构感知指标；分层重构与查询优化承袭已有提示提取与黑盒攻击技术。
scope: 适用于暴露动作或后处理输出的 LLM 服务与智能体框架；对多模态服务与完全拒绝类强护栏系统的提取上限未评估。
limitations: 目标服务集自建，真实商业服务覆盖有限；分层模板可能不匹配未见提示结构；防御侧缓解未评估。

title: BrainwashedLLM: Jailbreaking via Automated Adversarial Chain of Thoughts Discovery
abstract: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong performance on complex tasks by generating explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) reasoning, but the safety implications of this intermediate reasoning surface remain underexplored. We demonstrate that the reasoning trace itself is a powerful attack vector. Safety alignment in large models is substantially less robust to malicious reasoning embedded in the context than to direct imperative prompts. We introduce BrainwashedLLM, a weak-to-strong adversarial framework that automates the discovery of reasoning-based jailbreaks. First, we use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a Reinforcement Learning (RL) algorithm, with a multi-objective rule-based reward to fine-tune a small, white-box source model to generate adversarial reasoning traces. Crucially, the reward is computed entirely over the source's own reasoning trace. Second, we show that these traces transfer in a zero-shot manner. When traces are injected as input prefixes, they steer larger black-box LRMs to continue the adversarial reasoning and produce harmful outputs, without requiring prompt optimization, gradient access, or any form of output feedback from the target model. Across four state-of-the-art LRMs that span distinct architectures, BrainwashedLLM achieves ASR@5 between 0.74 and 0.98 across targets, within 16 points of query-based baselines, without querying the target during attack construction. To our knowledge, this is the first framework to use RL to directly optimize the CoT of LRMs as an attack surface without any target feedback, and the first to demonstrate zero-shot weak-to-strong transfer of reasoning traces. Our results suggest that exposed CoT is a vulnerability in LRMs and motivate architectural defenses that isolate the reasoning buffer. Warning: This paper contains potentially offensive and harmful text.
title_cn: BrainwashedLLM：经由自动化对抗思维链发现的越狱
abstract_cn: 大型推理模型（LRM）通过生成显式思维链（CoT）推理在复杂任务上取得强性能，但这一中间推理面的安全影响仍未被充分探索。我们证明推理轨迹本身就是强大的攻击向量：安全对齐对嵌入上下文的恶意推理的鲁棒性远低于对直接指令式提示。我们提出 BrainwashedLLM，一个从弱到强的对抗框架，自动化发现基于推理的越狱。首先，用带多目标规则奖励的强化学习算法 GRPO 微调一个小型白盒源模型生成对抗推理轨迹；关键在于奖励完全在源模型自身的推理轨迹上计算。其次，这些轨迹以零样本方式迁移：作为输入前缀注入时，它们引导更大的黑盒 LRM 继续对抗推理并产生有害输出，无需提示优化、梯度访问或任何来自目标模型的输出反馈。跨四个覆盖不同架构的 SOTA LRM，BrainwashedLLM 取得 ASR@5 在 0.74 到 0.98 之间，与基于查询的基线相差 16 个点以内，且在攻击构造期间不查询目标。据我们所知，这是首个用 RL 直接优化 LRM 的 CoT 作为攻击面且不依赖目标反馈的框架，也是首个展示推理轨迹零样本弱到强迁移的工作。结果表明暴露的 CoT 是 LRM 的脆弱性，催生隔离推理缓冲区的架构防御。警告：本文包含潜在冒犯性与有害文本。
summary_cn: 提出 BrainwashedLLM：用 GRPO 在白盒小模型上以自身推理轨迹为奖励优化对抗 CoT，零样本注入为前缀即可操控更大黑盒 LRM，4 个 SOTA 推理模型 ASR@5 达 0.74–0.98，且攻击构造全程不查询目标。
objective_summary: 训练小型白盒源模型生成对抗思维链前缀，测量其零样本注入后对四个黑盒推理模型的攻击成功率，并与查询式越狱基线比较成本与迁移性。
evidence_note: 4 个 SOTA LRM 上 ASR@5 0.74–0.98、与查询式基线差距 16 点内的系统对比；评测集与判定标准未详述，无统计检验。
novelty_note: 首个以 RL 直接优化 CoT 为攻击面且不依赖目标反馈、首个展示推理轨迹零样本弱到强迁移的框架；RL 微调与前缀注入组件承袭已有越狱研究。
scope: 适用于暴露或可被注入思维链上下文的推理模型；对推理缓冲隔离、CoT 摘要化等架构防御未评估；奖励依赖白盒源模型可用性。
limitations: 需训练白盒源模型（计算与数据成本）；ASR 判定可能包含误报；未评估对齐更新后攻击的持久性。

title: Proving the Wrong Program: Miscompilations as a Threat to zkVM Guarantees
abstract: A zero-knowledge virtual machine (zkVM) lets an untrusted prover convince a verifier that a program, typically Rust compiled to RISC-V, ran correctly. The proof covers the compiled binary, so a miscompilation can make a correct zkVM produce a valid proof of a computation that differs from the developer's source. We present the first empirical study of miscompilation as a threat to zkVM guarantees, on the production zkVMs SP1 and Jolt. We assemble 88 known rustc and LLVM miscompilations with Rust reproducers, using an LLM agent to recover Rust triggers for 60 of 124 LLVM bugs reported only as LLVM IR. Many of the bugs carry over to zkVMs: 48 of the 88 make a guest commit a wrong output on SP1 and 46 on Jolt, including the same 15 rustc bugs on both. Most bugs that do not reproduce never reach the faulty code on the zkVM's target, e.g. because they need an instruction-set extension. Existing guest programs are rarely affected by accident. Across 13 guests of 10 popular SP1 projects, the buggy and the fixed compiler produce byte-identical binaries in 447 of the 552 guest-bug pairs that build, and the other 105 have the same code or agree on every input we ran. An attacker who contributes code to a guest, however, can trigger these bugs on purpose. For about $40 per project, an LLM agent found patches that look like ordinary optimisations, preserve the behaviour of the guest's source, and expose a known bug in 12 of 366 project-bug pairs, across 11 of 20 projects. In four cases the guest commits a wrong output, including an Ethereum client that rejects a valid block, and in the other eight it fails on a valid input. Reviewing or formally verifying the zkVM or the guest's source cannot catch such a patch, because both are correct. zkVM projects should treat their compiler as part of their trusted base and track the known bugs of their toolchain.
title_cn: 证明错误的程序：误编译对 zkVM 保证的威胁
abstract_cn: 零知识虚拟机（zkVM）让不受信的证明者使验证者相信某个程序（通常是编译到 RISC-V 的 Rust）正确运行。证明覆盖的是编译后的二进制，因此误编译可以使正确的 zkVM 产生一个与开发者源码不同的计算的有效证明。我们在生产级 zkVM SP1 与 Jolt 上首次实证研究误编译对 zkVM 保证的威胁。我们汇集 88 个带 Rust 复现器的已知 rustc 与 LLVM 误编译，用 LLM 智能体为 124 个仅以 LLVM IR 报告的 LLVM bug 中的 60 个恢复 Rust 触发器。许多 bug 会带到 zkVM：88 个中有 48 个使 guest 在 SP1 上提交错误输出，Jolt 上为 46 个，包括两平台上相同的 15 个 rustc bug。多数未复现的 bug 从未在 zkVM 目标上到达故障代码，例如需要指令集扩展。现有 guest 程序很少偶然受影响：在 10 个流行 SP1 项目的 13 个 guest 上，有 bug 与已修复编译器在 552 个可构建的 guest-bug 对中的 447 个产生字节相同的二进制，其余 105 个在我们运行的所有输入上行为一致。然而，向 guest 贡献代码的攻击者可以故意触发这些 bug：在每个项目约 40 美元的成本下，LLM 智能体在 366 个项目-bug 对中的 12 个（跨 20 个项目中的 11 个）找到看似普通优化、保持 guest 源码行为却暴露已知 bug 的补丁；其中 4 例 guest 提交错误输出——包括一个拒绝有效区块的以太坊客户端，其余 8 例在有效输入上失败。审查或形式化验证 zkVM 或 guest 源码都无法捕获此类补丁，因为二者都正确。zkVM 项目应把编译器视为可信基础的一部分并跟踪其工具链的已知 bug。
summary_cn: 首次实证 zkVM 误编译威胁：88 个已知 rustc/LLVM bug 中 48 个使 SP1 guest 提交错误输出（Jolt 46 个）；LLM 以约 40 美元/项目成本生成伪装优化的补丁，在 12/366 项目-bug 对暴露 bug，含以太坊客户端拒有效区块。
objective_summary: 汇集带 Rust 复现器的已知编译器误编译并在生产 zkVM SP1 与 Jolt 上复现，测量其对真实 guest 项目的偶发影响，并用 LLM 智能体评估低成本故意触发补丁的可行性与后果。
evidence_note: 首个系统实证：88 个已知 bug 的复现、10 个流行项目的 13 个 guest 全量对比（552 对中 447 字节一致）、LLM 攻击实验量化成本（约 40 美元/项目）与后果。
novelty_note: 首次把证明二进制而非源码这一 zkVM 结构性缺口与真实编译器 bug 数据库连接，并量化故意触发的低成本可行性；单个编译器 bug 与 LLM 生成补丁组件为已有技术。
scope: 适用于以 RISC-V Rust 为主线、证明编译产物的 zkVM（SP1/Jolt）；对非 LLVM 工具链、电路级 ZK 系统与运行时 JIT 不适用。
limitations: 复现限于已知 bug 列表，未知误编译未覆盖；LLM 补丁搜索的覆盖率受预算限制；未提出 zkVM 侧检测机制。

title: Right Tool, Wrong Parameters: Defending LLM Agents Against Parameter Poisoning
abstract: Indirect Prompt Injection (IPI) poses a critical threat to LLM agents. Existing defenses largely focus on whether an injection induces a new tool invocation or unintended action. In this paper, we study a different attack surface, parameter poisoning, where the attacker preserves the intended action but manipulates one or more tool arguments, such as a recipient or other task-critical value. Such attacks are difficult to detect because no new action is introduced, while parameter changes themselves are often legitimate parts of the user's request. Our key insight is that the legitimacy of a parameter change should be determined by the trust of the information flow that produces it under the user query. The query induces a task-specific trust hierarchy over available information fields: some are trusted to determine particular parameters, while others should have little or no influence. Based on this insight, we propose AuthorityFlow, a three-stage parameter-level defense. First, it interprets the user query to construct a task-specific trust hierarchy over the information fields available to the agent. Second, for each tool argument, it traces the information flow that produces its current value and attributes the value to its supporting field. Finally, it accepts the value only when that field is trusted to determine the parameter under the current task, allowing high-trust changes while flagging low-trust influence as potential parameter poisoning. We further introduce FactAuthBench for evaluating parameter poisoning in LLM agents. Without defense, the attack success rate reaches 93.06%. AuthorityFlow reduces it to 9.03%, while retaining 82.64% benign task utility compared with 90.28% without defense. Our results show that effective IPI defense requires reasoning not only about what action an agent takes, but also about which information is trusted to determine its parameters.
title_cn: 工具没错，参数有诈：防御 LLM 智能体的参数投毒
abstract_cn: 间接提示注入（IPI）对 LLM 智能体构成关键威胁。现有防御主要关注注入是否诱发新的工具调用或非预期动作。本文研究一个不同的攻击面——参数投毒：攻击者保留预期动作但操纵一个或多个工具参数，如收款人或其他任务关键值。这类攻击难以检测，因为没有引入新动作，而参数变化本身常是用户请求的合法部分。我们的核心洞察是：参数变化的合法性应由在用户查询下产生它的信息流的信任决定。查询在可用信息字段上诱导出任务特定的信任层级：某些字段被信任决定特定参数，另一些则不应有影响。基于此洞察，我们提出三阶段参数级防御 AuthorityFlow。第一，解释用户查询，在智能体可用的信息字段上构建任务特定信任层级。第二，对每个工具参数，追踪产生其当前值的信息流并把该值归因到支撑字段。最后，仅当该字段在当前任务下被信任决定该参数时接受该值，允许高信任变化，同时把低信任影响标记为潜在参数投毒。我们还引入用于评估 LLM 智能体参数投毒的 FactAuthBench。无防御时攻击成功率达 93.06%；AuthorityFlow 将其降至 9.03%，同时保持 82.64% 的良性任务效用（无防御为 90.28%）。结果表明，有效的 IPI 防御不仅需要推理智能体采取什么动作，还需要推理哪些信息被信任决定其参数。
summary_cn: 提出参数投毒这一新 IPI 攻击面（不改动作只改收款人等关键参数）与三阶段信息流信任防御 AuthorityFlow：在自建 FactAuthBench 上把攻击成功率从 93.06% 压到 9.03%，良性效用保持 82.64%（无防御 90.28%）。
objective_summary: 定义参数投毒攻击面并构建评测基准 FactAuthBench，实现按任务信任层级归因参数来源信息流的三阶段防御 AuthorityFlow，量化攻击成功率与良性效用损失。
evidence_note: 在自建 FactAuthBench 上系统量化攻击（93.06%）与防御（9.03%）及效用损失（90.28%→82.64%）；基准与攻击集自建，无外部数据或统计检验。
novelty_note: 把 IPI 防御焦点从动作级转到参数级是实质新攻击面，信息流信任层级归因是可操作的防御机制；信任层级思想承袭污染分析传统。
scope: 适用于以工具调用为核心动作空间、参数含任务关键值的 LLM 智能体；对多步参数级联与跨会话投毒未评估。
limitations: 信任层级由 LLM 从查询解释生成，可能被构造性查询误导；评估限于自建基准；防御依赖参数归因的准确性，高并发场景开销未测。

title: The Devil is in the Context: Nine Dimensions of Prompt Injection Attacks
abstract: Prompt injection is usually discussed and evaluated as a single, homogeneous type of attack. However, vulnerabilities reported in real-world systems show that prompt injections vary widely. Moreover, the same instruction can be a prompt injection in one context and a legitimate request in another, depending on the user's intent and the system's policies. Ignoring this variation leaves gaps in how defenses are evaluated, and can give a false sense of security against real-world attacks. We identify nine dimensions along which prompt injection attacks differ. Together, they form a taxonomy that describes the injected instruction itself, its relation to the user's task, and how it manifests in the target system. Each dimension affects which defenses can detect or prevent an attack. We first use the taxonomy to characterize six real-world prompt injection vulnerabilities, showing how much these attacks differ. We then apply it to nine prompt injection benchmarks and find that most cover only a small region of this space. Combining benchmarks helps, but 13% of pairwise category combinations remain untested, mostly among the less commonly represented categories. Finally, we show that the taxonomy supports automated annotation of benchmarks and targeted generation of new test cases to fill these gaps. The taxonomy is also useful beyond benchmarks. Defense authors can use it to state which types of prompt injection they evaluated against, and system operators can use it to identify which attacks apply to their system and choose defenses to match.
title_cn: 魔鬼在上下文中：提示注入攻击的九个维度
abstract_cn: 提示注入通常被当作单一同质攻击类型来讨论与评估。然而真实系统报告的漏洞表明，提示注入差异极大。而且同一指令在一个上下文中是提示注入、在另一个上下文中是合法请求，取决于用户意图与系统策略。忽视这种差异会在防御评估中留下缺口，并可能对真实攻击产生虚假安全感。我们识别出提示注入攻击沿以区分的九个维度，共同构成一个描述注入指令本身、其与用户任务的关系及其在目标系统中表现方式的分类法。每个维度影响哪些防御能够检测或阻止攻击。我们首先用该分类法刻画六个真实提示注入漏洞，展示这些攻击差异之大；然后应用于九个提示注入基准，发现多数只覆盖该空间的一小区域；组合基准有帮助，但 13% 的成对类别组合仍未被测试，多见于代表性不足的类别。最后，我们展示该分类法支持对基准的自动标注与针对性生成新测试用例以填补缺口。该分类法在基准之外亦有用途：防御作者可用它声明针对哪些提示注入类型做了评估，系统运营者可用它识别适用于自己系统的攻击并选择匹配的防御。
summary_cn: 提出提示注入的九维分类法（注入指令本身、与任务关系、系统内表现），刻画 6 个真实漏洞并审计 9 个基准：多数覆盖仅一小区域、13% 成对类别组合未被测；支持自动标注与定向生成补缺。
objective_summary: 构建提示注入攻击的九维分类法，用它刻画真实漏洞、审计九个基准的类别覆盖并量化未测组合比例，同时验证其在自动标注与定向测试生成上的可用性。
evidence_note: 对 6 个真实漏洞与 9 个基准的系统映射，量化 13% 未测组合并演示自动标注与生成；无受控对照实验，标注质量与生成用例的有效性未给出数值验证。
novelty_note: 九维分解比二元提示注入分类更细，并提供可操作的基准覆盖审计方法；维度内容（注入位置、任务关系、可见性等）承袭已有提示注入分析。
scope: 适用于文本提示注入的描述、基准设计与防御声明；对多模态注入、非 LLM 代理系统与防御机制本身的有效性不做评估。
limitations: 维度划分依赖人工归纳，边界情形（合法指令还是注入）依赖策略语义；基准样本有限；未测量防御在各维度上的真实差距。

title: VeriSpoof: Beyond Real or Fake with One Audio LLM
abstract: A speech deepfake detector estimates whether a recording is synthetic, but a forensic analyst also asks which system produced it, whether recordings share a source, and what evidence supports each conclusion. We present VeriSpoof, an audio language model that unifies five tasks with shared weights: deepfake detection, generator attribution (generator, acoustic model and vocoder), recording-condition analysis, synthesized-span localisation, and source verification. Each decision is supported by grounded rationales whose statements can be independently verified. Answers are scored by sentence likelihood, allowing detection and source verification to be thresholded without separate heads. Rationale statements can be checked against waveform measurements, span labels, or generator metadata. Counterfactual examples train decisions to follow the stated evidence. Across the 14 Speech-DF-Arena test sets, VeriSpoof-Plus achieves 2.14% pooled EER, ranking third of 28 systems and first among open-weight systems. VeriSpoof-Base, trained only on official training splits of eight corpora, achieves 4.43% EER, less than half that of the next open-weight detector. With the same weights, VeriSpoof-Plus verifies whether recordings from generators unseen in training share a source at 6.2% EER. Controlled studies show that the audio representation governs detection, the LLM governs recording comparison, and source supervision is necessary for neural-codec fakes. Statement-checkable rationales catch partial fakes missed by one-step answers (99.6% vs. 78.4% on PartialEdit) and determine decisions under edits unseen in training (99.5%). Training updates only 29.7M of 2.85B parameters, fitting a single 24 GB GPU with gradient checkpointing. We release both models, inference code, a demo, and VeriSpoof-Bench, the evaluation suite covering these questions.
title_cn: VeriSpoof：用一个音频 LLM 超越真/假二分
abstract_cn: 语音深伪检测器估计录音是否为合成，但取证分析员还要问：它由哪个系统生成、多段录音是否同源、每个结论有什么证据支撑。我们提出 VeriSpoof，一个以共享权重统一五个任务的音频语言模型：深伪检测、生成器归因（生成器、声学模型与声码器）、录音条件分析、合成片段定位与来源验证。每个决策都由可独立验证的、有依据的理由支撑。答案按句子似然打分，使检测与来源验证无需独立头即可设阈值。理由陈述可对照波形测量、片段标签或生成器元数据核验。反事实示例训练决策跟随所述证据。在 14 个 Speech-DF-Arena 测试集上，VeriSpoof-Plus 达到 2.14% 合并 EER，在 28 个系统中排第三、开源系统中第一。仅在八个语料官方训练集上训练的 VeriSpoof-Base 达到 4.43% EER，不到次优开源检测器的一半。以相同权重，VeriSpoof-Plus 对训练中未见生成器的录音验证同源性达 6.2% EER。受控研究表明：音频表征主导检测，LLM 主导录音比较，来源监督对神经编解码器伪造必不可少。可核验的理由陈述能发现一步式答案漏掉的局部伪造（PartialEdit 上 99.6% 对 78.4%），并在训练未见的编辑下判定决策（99.5%）。训练只更新 2.85B 参数中的 29.7M，配合梯度检查点可装入单张 24GB GPU。我们发布两个模型、推理代码、演示与覆盖这些问题的评测套件 VeriSpoof-Bench。
summary_cn: 统一深伪检测、生成器归因、录音条件、片段定位与同源验证五任务的音频 LLM：Speech-DF-Arena 上 2.14% EER（28 系统第三、开源第一），可核验理由使 PartialEdit 检出 99.6% 对 78.4%，模型与基准全量开源。
objective_summary: 构建共享权重的多任务语音取证音频 LLM，以句子似然打分支持阈值化与可核验理由，用反事实训练对齐证据与决策，在 Speech-DF-Arena 及受控消融中定位音频表征、LLM 与来源监督的分工。
evidence_note: 28 系统 14 测试集的公开 Arena 排名（2.14% EER、开源第一）、受控消融定位三个组件贡献、PartialEdit 等对比（99.6% 对 78.4%）、模型代码与基准全量发布。
novelty_note: 五任务统一加语句级可核验理由是新系统设计；底座为已有音频 LLM 与深伪检测/归因范式，评测框架 Speech-DF-Arena 亦为既有资源。
scope: 适用于语音深伪取证与来源验证任务；排名基于 Speech-DF-Arena 测试分布，对跨语言、信道失配与对抗性后处理的鲁棒性未系统评估。
limitations: 仅更新 29.7M 参数（适配式训练），任务覆盖受训练语料构成限制；理由核验依赖参考元数据可得；未报告对抗攻击下的脆弱性。

title: Perseus: A Full-Stack System for Homomorphic Model Inference
abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have made it exceptionally convenient for users to send their private data to model providers, which process them in plaintext. Fully Homomorphic Encryption (FHE) promises to secure remote inference by computing directly on encrypted data, yet it has remained prohibitively slow. The effort to make it practical remains fragmented, with most existing frameworks being closed-source, which keeps progress from compounding. We present Perseus, a free and open Python software library that supports the full stack of encrypted model inference, from the cryptographic backend and data packing, to encrypted nonlinearities and end-to-end model execution. Perseus ships with built-in novel optimizations, one at each level of the stack: in-kernel regeneration of key-switching keys at the (i) backend level, a complex variant of Cachemir packing at the (ii) data level, and a state-of-the-art bootstrap placer that is both packing- and magnitude-aware at the (iii) model level. Perseus achieves state-of-the-art latency across multiple models and modalities, within $3\%$ of the plaintext models' accuracy and perplexity. Remarkably, it is $3.96\times$ faster at single-token decoding than any other implementation on Llama-3-8B. We initiate, for the first time, a public speedrun on encrypted GPT-2, so that progress can compound.
title_cn: Perseus：面向同态模型推理的全栈系统
abstract_cn: 大语言模型（LLM）让用户把私有数据以明文发给模型提供商变得异常便利。全同态加密（FHE）承诺通过直接在加密数据上计算来保护远程推理，但始终慢得难以实用。使其实用化的努力仍然碎片化，多数现有框架闭源，导致进展无法叠加。我们提出 Perseus，一个支持加密模型推理全栈的免费开源 Python 软件库：从密码后端与数据打包，到加密非线性与端到端模型执行。Perseus 内置多项新优化，分布在栈的每一层：后端层的核内密钥切换密钥再生成、数据层的 Cachemir 打包复杂变体、模型层的既感知打包又感知幅度的最先进 bootstrap 放置器。Perseus 在多个模型与模态上达到最先进时延，精度与困惑度在明文模型的 3% 以内。值得注意的是，在 Llama-3-8B 上其单 token 解码比任何其他实现快 3.96 倍。我们首次发起加密 GPT-2 的公开速度竞赛，使进展得以叠加。
summary_cn: 开源全栈 FHE 推理库 Perseus：三层新优化（核内密钥切换再生成、复杂 Cachemir 打包、打包与幅度感知 bootstrap 放置）使 Llama-3-8B 单 token 解码快 3.96 倍、精度损失 ≤3%，并发起首个加密 GPT-2 公开速度赛。
objective_summary: 实现覆盖密码后端、数据打包、加密非线性与端到端执行的 FHE 推理开源库 Perseus，在栈的三个层级引入新优化，并在多模型上与其他实现比较时延与精度、发起公开速度基准。
evidence_note: 开源真实系统，多模型多模态 SOTA 时延对比、与明文基线的精度差 ≤3%、Llama-3-8B 单 token 3.96 倍加速；公开速度赛可持续复核。
novelty_note: 价值主要在全栈开源整合与三项工程级优化（密钥切换再生成、打包变体、bootstrap 放置），密码原语与推理管线承袭已有 FHE 库工作。
scope: 适用于基于 FHE 的加密神经网络推理（LLM 解码与 GPT-2 类模型）；对训练、超大批量服务与替代密码后端的适配未评估。
limitations: 4 页短文，优化消融与实现细节有限；加密推理仍远慢于明文；依赖特定后端参数配置。

title: A Security Analysis of Verifiable Credential Verification Pipelines: Attack Surface Arising from JSON-LD/RDFC Canonicalization Compared with SD-JWT VC and mdoc
abstract: We evaluate, at implementation level and under an explicit threat model, the verification pipelines of three Verifiable Credential (VC) formats: SD-JWT VC; the W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0 with the Data Integrity cryptosuite eddsa-rdfc-2022 (W3C VCDM); and mdoc (ISO/IEC 18013-5). For W3C VCDM we identify and exercise three structural attack surfaces from remote context resolution and RDFC-1.0 canonicalization: denial of service (DoS) via poison graphs, context injection through @context, and server-side request forgery (SSRF) reachable via malicious URLs, all at default settings. A poison graph, whose blank-node references are symmetric enough to force RDFC-1.0 into deep recursion, raises it to 278x the baseline from five blank nodes in 527 bytes, and to 13.5 s from eight. Every experiment ran in four environments sharing runtime and library versions; the multiple moves with the machine (251--424x for one input), not with its speed. Cost tracks that symmetry rather than the node count: an acyclic input with 1,500 blank nodes stays at 462--714x. A call limit separates the two: every attack family aborts at 16 or below, every legitimate credential completes at 1, but a shallow, wide recursion, such as the acyclic control, passes whatever the bound. DoS does not presuppose adversarial input: with production education schemas, canonicalization costs 23--34x a simple credential in one environment, 16--49x across four. Effective mitigations are a static document loader, which removes the retrieval latency and both remote-context surfaces; a context allowlist; and a call limit with a size bound. SD-JWT VC and mdoc need neither canonicalization nor external references, and our verifiers resisted every vector evaluated. These are not format-specific defects but properties of the pipeline and its configuration.
comment: 23 pages, 2 figures, 11 tables. Companion paper: arXiv:2611.03493. Measurement kit and raw result files: this https URL
title_cn: 可验证凭证验证流水线的安全分析：JSON-LD/RDFC 规范化带来的攻击面，与 SD-JWT VC 及 mdoc 的对比
abstract_cn: 我们在实现层面、在明确威胁模型下评估三种可验证凭证（VC）格式的验证流水线：SD-JWT VC；采用 Data Integrity 密码套件 eddsa-rdfc-2022 的 W3C Verifiable Credentials Data Model 2.0（W3C VCDM）；以及 mdoc（ISO/IEC 18013-5）。对 W3C VCDM，我们从远程上下文解析与 RDFC-1.0 规范化中识别并演练三个结构性攻击面：经由毒图的拒绝服务（DoS）、经由 @context 的上下文注入，以及经恶意 URL 可达的服务器端请求伪造（SSRF），全部在默认设置下成立。一个空节点引用足够对称、迫使 RDFC-1.0 进入深递归的毒图，仅用 5 个空节点、527 字节就把成本抬到基线的 278 倍，8 个空节点时达到 13.5 秒。每个实验都在共享运行时与库版本的四个环境中运行；随机器变化的是倍数（一个输入为 251–424 倍），而非其速度。成本跟踪的是对称性而非节点数：含 1,500 个空节点的无环输入停留在 462–714 倍。调用上限可区分两类：所有攻击家族在 ≤16 次时中止，每个合法凭证在 1 次完成，但浅而宽的递归（如无环对照）不受该上限影响。DoS 不需要对抗性输入：使用生产教育类 schema，规范化成本在一个环境中达简单凭证的 23–34 倍、四环境 16–49 倍。有效缓解包括静态文档加载器（消除检索时延与两个远程上下文攻击面）、上下文允许列表、以及带大小上限的调用上限。SD-JWT VC 与 mdoc 既不需要规范化也不需要外部引用，我们的验证器抵御了所有已评估向量。这些并非格式特有缺陷，而是流水线及其配置的属性。
summary_cn: 系统评估三种 VC 格式验证流水线：W3C VCDM 的 RDFC 规范化存在毒图 DoS（527 字节达 278 倍成本、13.5 秒）、上下文注入与 SSRF 三个默认即成的攻击面，SD-JWT VC 与 mdoc 抵御全部向量；给出静态加载器、允许列表与调用上限缓解。
objective_summary: 在统一威胁模型与四个环境中对 SD-JWT VC、W3C VCDM 与 mdoc 验证流水线做实现级攻击面评估，量化 RDFC-1.0 规范化的毒图递归成本、上下文注入与 SSRF 可行性，并检验静态加载器等缓解的效果。
evidence_note: 四个共享运行时与库版本环境的受控测量、全向量默认设置演练、生产 schema 的非对抗成本基线、缓解有效性验证，并附测量套件与原始结果（配套论文 arXiv:2611.03493）。
novelty_note: 把 RDFC-1.0 规范化的对称性递归 DoS 原语带入 VC 验证并做跨格式实现级对比，属有诊断价值的系统性安全分析；毒图与 SSRF 类向量在 JSON-LD 语境已有相关讨论。
scope: 适用于启用远程上下文解析与 RDFC 规范化的 W3C VCDM 验证实现；对其他 Data Integrity 套件、非 Web 环境部署与签发侧攻击面未覆盖。
limitations: 结论依赖所选验证器实现与库版本；成本倍数随机器波动大（251–424 倍）；缓解需部署方配置变更，未评估生态迁移阻力。

title: TxBench: A Benchmark of Attack Transactions and Evidence-Backed Negatives on Seven EVM Chains
abstract: Researchers evaluate detectors of malicious smart-contract transactions on datasets that each paper assembles anew. Their positives come from incident trackers, whose citations mix attacks with setup steps and transactions that never ran, or from a detector's own output, which makes the evaluation circular; their negatives are ordinary transactions. A shared benchmark needs positives whose own execution shows the attack and negatives that use the attacks' mechanisms, with no detector deciding either label. We present TxBench, a benchmark of attack transactions and evidence-backed negatives on seven EVM chains, with the five-step pipeline that builds it. The pipeline collects every transaction that BlockSec's incident library or the EVM Hack Registry cites, maps its weakness to OWASP's SCWE taxonomy, and rebuilds its execution from free data sources. A cited transaction qualifies as a valid TxBench attack only if it extracts value from others during execution, is consistent with all verified source claims, and is independently linked to the reported incident by corroborating evidence. Negative examples are sampled from each chain's traffic near the attacks and retained only when positive evidence confirms their legitimacy. Of 1,850 cited transactions, TxBench accepts 1,012 attacks from 602 incidents, worth USD 868.1 million: 846 contract exploits and 166 key compromises. A blind review under rules fixed in advance confirms 98 of 100 sampled attacks (97.7% weighted) and all 100 sampled negatives. As baselines, four zero-shot LLMs reading anonymized traces are precise but find at most 0.43 of the attacks and no key compromise, leaving ample room for better detectors.
title_cn: TxBench：七条 EVM 链上的攻击交易与证据支撑负样本基准
abstract_cn: 研究者在每篇论文自建的数据集上评估恶意智能合约交易检测器。其正样本来自事件追踪器，其引用混杂攻击与准备步骤以及从未执行的交易；或来自检测器自身的输出，使评估循环；其负样本是普通交易。共享基准需要的正样本是其自身执行即能体现攻击的交易，以及使用攻击机制但无检测器决定标签的负样本。我们提出 TxBench，一个覆盖七条 EVM 链的攻击交易与证据支撑负样本基准，及构建它的五步流水线。该流水线收集 BlockSec 事件库或 EVM Hack Registry 引用的每一笔交易，将其弱点映射到 OWASP SCWE 分类法，并从免费数据源重建其执行。一笔被引用的交易只有满足以下条件才被接受为有效的 TxBench 攻击：执行中从他方攫取价值、与所有经验证的来源声明一致、且有佐证证据独立关联到所报告事件。负样本从每条链上攻击附近的流量采样，仅在有正面证据确认其合法性时保留。在 1,850 笔被引用交易中，TxBench 接受来自 602 起事件的 1,012 笔攻击，价值 8.681 亿美元：846 笔合约攻击与 166 笔密钥失窃。按预先固定规则的盲审确认了抽样的 100 笔攻击中的 98 笔（加权 97.7%）与全部 100 笔负样本。作为基线，四个零样本 LLM 阅读匿名化追踪后精确但最多找出 0.43 的攻击，且找不到任何密钥失窃，留出巨大改进空间。
summary_cn: 发布 TxBench：七条 EVM 链、602 起事件、1,012 笔经执行重建与佐证验证的攻击交易（涉 8.681 亿美元，846 合约攻击+166 密钥失窃）与证据支撑负样本；盲审确认 97.7%，零样本 LLM 基线最多检出 0.43 且漏掉全部密钥失窃。
objective_summary: 构建跨七条 EVM 链的恶意交易基准与五步构建流水线：收集事件库引用交易、映射 OWASP SCWE、从公开数据重建执行、按价值攫取与佐证规则筛选正样本、以正面证据保留负样本，并做预固定规则盲审与零样本 LLM 基线评测。
evidence_note: 1,850 笔引用交易的全量重建与筛选、预先固定规则的盲审（攻击 97.7%、负样本 100%）、七链覆盖与四个零样本 LLM 基线；标签独立于任何检测器。
novelty_note: 首个以执行重建加独立佐证定义正样本、以正面证据定义负样本的智能合约攻击基准，解决引用混杂与检测器循环两大评估缺陷；SCWE 映射与数据源均为已有资源。
scope: 适用于 EVM 兼容链上的历史攻击交易检测评估；对 MEV 类灰色行为、未公开事件与跨链攻击的代表性有限；负样本为已验证合法而非全量正常分布。
limitations: 覆盖限于 BlockSec/EVM Hack Registry 已收录事件；执行重建依赖归档数据可得性；LLM 基线仅零样本设置，未测微调或专用检测器。

title: Averaging Collusion Breaks Traceability in Personalized Neural Audio Watermarking
abstract: Personalized neural audio watermarking systems embed user-specific payloads into audio to trace the user associated with a leaked or misused copy. Existing evaluations mainly assume access to a single personalized copy, but real-world distribution may expose multiple copies of the same recording. We find that simple sample-wise averaging breaks traceability: averaging only two copies produces tracing-failure rates of 87.7-99.7% across the five systems while largely preserving audio quality. Decoder outputs show distinct responses to coalition payload composition across systems, with high majority agreement in TimbreWM but substantially lower agreement in WMCodec. In a more sophisticated payload-aware setting, mixture weighting can further steer the decoder toward a selected nonmember, achieving a target success rate of 92.3% in TimbreWM. Preliminary confidence screening rejects many collusion-induced assignments while retaining most valid single-copy outputs. Code and results are available at https://github.com/Silwan5z/neural-audio-watermark-collusion-attack. This work highlights multi-copy traceability as an additional evaluation dimension for personalized neural audio watermarking alongside conventional single-copy robustness.
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to ICASSP 2027. Code and results available at this https URL
title_cn: 平均合并共谋破坏个性化神经音频水印的可追踪性
abstract_cn: 个性化神经音频水印系统在音频中嵌入用户特定载荷，以追踪与泄露或滥用副本关联的用户。现有评估主要假设可访问单个个性化副本，但现实分发可能暴露同一录音的多个副本。我们发现简单的逐样本平均即可破坏可追踪性：仅平均两个副本就在五个系统上产生 87.7–99.7% 的追踪失败率，同时大体保持音频质量。解码器输出显示各系统对共谋载荷组成的响应不同：TimbreWM 中多数一致率高，而 WMCodec 中一致率明显更低。在更复杂的载荷感知设置中，混合加权可进一步把解码器引向选定的非成员，在 TimbreWM 上达到 92.3% 的目标成功率。初步的置信度筛选能拒绝许多共谋导致的指派，同时保留大多数有效的单副本输出。代码与结果已公开。本工作凸显多副本可追踪性应作为个性化神经音频水印在传统单副本鲁棒性之外的又一评估维度。
summary_cn: 发现逐样本平均共谋即可击穿个性化神经音频水印追踪：仅合并 2 个副本就使 5 个系统追踪失败率达 87.7–99.7%，载荷感知混合加权更可定向嫁祸（TimbreWM 达 92.3%），提出多副本可追踪性为新的评估维度。
objective_summary: 在五个个性化神经音频水印系统上测量副本平均与载荷感知混合加权对可追踪性的破坏，报告追踪失败率、解码器行为差异与置信度筛选的保留/拒绝比例，并公开攻击代码与结果。
evidence_note: 5 个已发表系统上的量化攻击评估（追踪失败率 87.7–99.7%、定向成功率 92.3%），含系统间解码行为对比与置信度筛选分析；学术系统、样本规模未详述、ICASSP 2027 在投。
novelty_note: 把共谋鲁棒性引入个性化神经音频水印评估是新的场景与评估维度；平均/加权混合攻击承袭传统水印共谋与指纹编码的已知思路。
scope: 适用于嵌入用户特定载荷、支持多用户分发的神经音频水印；结论限于所测 5 个系统与逐样本平均类共谋，抗共谋编码或感知混淆方案未评估。
limitations: 仅测试平均与简单加权两类共谋；追踪失败率依赖系统的检测阈值设置；未提出防御方案，仅建议增加评估维度。

title: Voluntary Servitude: Weaponized Safety Warning Mechanisms for Controlling AI Agents
abstract: LLM agents increasingly act on information retrieved from public sources they treat as credible, which turns a manipulated recommendation into a transaction, a dependency, or a decision with physical consequences. The security literature models this threat as instruction injection, in which an adversary writes a command into retrieved content and deployed defenses learn to recognize command syntax. We show that an attacker can instead steer an agent through the agent's own harm-avoidance. A single fabricated hazard, written as an ordinary review, leads the agent to disqualify the legitimate options and select the attacker's target by its own reasoning, with no command for a detector to recognize. We call this voluntary servitude. These payloads steer agents about as often as instruction injection (60.4% vs. 66.0%), and deployed injection detectors score them as benign, so behind a filter they are 1.7-4.4x more effective. We measure this at the generation stage across six models and ten consumer-service domains, for three attack families, and show that it transfers to production browser agents, outperforming instruction injection, and to a retrieval pipeline (1.0-57.0% end-to-end success, depending on the retriever). We then show that a corroboration requirement added to the agent's instructions removes roughly 95% of the exposure against a non-adaptive attacker without retraining. With the requirement in place, the agent still reads the planted hazard and no longer acts on it.
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Main Track). 17 pages, 7 figures, 8 tables
title_cn: 自愿为奴：被武器化的安全预警机制对 AI 智能体的操控
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益依据其视为可信的公开来源信息采取行动，这使一条被操纵的推荐变成一笔交易、一个依赖或一个有物理后果的决定。安全文献把这一威胁建模为指令注入：攻击者把命令写入检索内容，已部署的防御学习识别命令语法。我们证明攻击者可以转而经由智能体自身的避害机制来操控它。一条写成普通评论的虚假危害信息，就能让智能体用自己的推理否决合法选项并选中攻击者的目标——没有可供检测器识别的命令。我们称之为自愿为奴（voluntary servitude）。这类载荷的操控频率与指令注入相当（60.4% 对 66.0%），而已部署的注入检测器将其评为良性，因此在过滤器背后其有效性高 1.7–4.4 倍。我们在六个模型、十个消费服务领域、三个攻击家族上于生成阶段测量这一点，并证明其可迁移到生产浏览器智能体——优于指令注入——以及一个检索流水线（端到端成功率 1.0–57.0%，取决于检索器）。随后我们证明：在智能体指令中加入需要佐证的要求，可在不重训的情况下消除约 95% 的非适应性攻击暴露。加入该要求后，智能体仍会读到植入的危害信息，但不再据此行动。
summary_cn: NeurIPS 2026：提出自愿为奴攻击——用普通评论形式的虚假危害借智能体自身避害机制否决合法选项，操控率 60.4%（与指令注入 66.0% 相当）且被现有检测器评为良性（过滤器后有效性 1.7–4.4 倍）；指令加佐证要求可消除约 95% 暴露。
objective_summary: 定义并量化经由虚假安全预警操控 LLM 智能体决策的攻击家族，在 6 个模型、10 个领域、3 个攻击家族上与指令注入比较成功率与检测器反应，并评估生产浏览器智能体、检索流水线及佐证要求缓解的有效性。
evidence_note: NeurIPS 2026 主会录用；6 个模型 × 10 个消费领域 × 3 个攻击家族的生成阶段测量，含生产浏览器智能体与检索流水线的端到端验证及缓解消融。
novelty_note: 揭示以智能体自身避害机制为载荷的新攻击向量，绕过以命令语法为目标的注入检测，扩展间接操纵的威胁模型；与虚假评论类内容操纵相关但机制与量化为新。
scope: 适用于依据检索内容行动的 LLM 智能体与浏览器智能体；攻击依赖目标选项与虚假危害可在同一选择集内比较的场景，对无检索的封闭任务不适用。
limitations: 佐证要求缓解仅对非适应性攻击有效，攻击者可伪造佐证；成功率随领域与检索器波动大（1.0–57.0%）；未评估多轮持续操控。

title: CloakFEM: Agentic FEM Code Generation for Red-Teaming Computational Resource Exhaustion
abstract: Finite element method (FEM) solvers are foundational to scientific and engineering simulation, yet their susceptibility to \emph{efficiency attacks} remains largely unexplored. An adversary can craft syntactically valid and runnable FEM programs that complete successfully while forcing excessive computational work, enabling computational denial-of-service (DoS) attacks. Finding such inputs is challenging because FEM programs occupy a vast, structured space constrained by numerical, geometric, and constitutive requirements. We introduce CloakFEM, a domain-guided LLM-agent framework for automatically generating runnable adversarial FEM programs that amplify solver computation. CloakFEM combines LLM-guided search with an FEM-specific intermediate representation and a deterministic validity gate that enforces runnable constraints. Across three FEM stacks, 17 problem classes, and 1,068 seeds, CloakFEM discovers adversarial inputs that substantially amplify solver work while remaining valid and solvable. In the most extreme case, solver iterations increase from 43 to 247,367, a \(5{,}752.72\times\) amplification. CloakFEM outperforms five generic black-box baselines and retains an advantage over evolutionary search under a controlled bounded action space. Cross-solver analysis further reveals both problem-intrinsic and solver-specific sources of vulnerability. Our results uncover an underexplored efficiency-attack surface in FEM solvers and show that runnable FEM programs can serve as adversarial inputs.
title_cn: CloakFEM：面向计算资源耗尽红队测试的智能体式 FEM 代码生成
abstract_cn: 有限元方法（FEM）求解器是科学与工程仿真的基础，但其对效率攻击的易感性基本未被探索。攻击者可以构造语法有效、可成功运行却迫使求解器做过量计算的 FEM 程序，实现计算拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。寻找此类输入充满挑战：FEM 程序占据受数值、几何与本构要求约束的巨大结构化空间。我们提出 CloakFEM，一个领域引导的 LLM 智能体框架，用于自动生成可运行、放大求解器计算量的对抗 FEM 程序。CloakFEM 将 LLM 引导的搜索与 FEM 专用中间表示及强制可运行约束的确定性有效性门相结合。跨三个 FEM 求解栈、17 个问题类与 1,068 个种子，CloakFEM 发现的对抗输入在保持有效可解的同时大幅放大求解器工作量。最极端情况下求解器迭代次数从 43 增至 247,367，放大 5,752.72 倍。CloakFEM 优于五个通用黑盒基线，并在受控有界动作空间下保持对进化搜索的优势。跨求解器分析进一步揭示了问题内在与求解器特定的脆弱性来源。我们的结果揭示了 FEM 求解器中一个欠探索的效率攻击面，并表明可运行的 FEM 程序可以作为对抗输入。
summary_cn: 提出 CloakFEM：LLM 智能体生成可运行的资源耗尽型对抗 FEM 程序，3 个求解栈、17 问题类、1,068 种子下最多把求解迭代从 43 次放大到 247,367 次（5,752.72 倍），优于 5 个黑盒基线。
objective_summary: 构建带 FEM 中间表示与确定性有效性门的 LLM 智能体搜索框架，自动生成可运行且放大求解器计算量的对抗程序，在三个 FEM 栈与多个问题类上量化放大倍数并与通用黑盒及进化搜索基线比较。
evidence_note: 3 个 FEM 求解栈 × 17 问题类 × 1,068 种子的系统实验，与 5 个黑盒基线及受控进化搜索对比，报告最大放大 5,752.72 倍；领域为学术求解器、无统计检验。
novelty_note: 开辟 FEM/科学计算求解器的效率攻击这一欠探索攻击面，把可运行性作为对抗输入约束是新的问题形式化；LLM 引导搜索与有效性门为已有组件的领域化组合。
scope: 适用于 FEM 类数值求解器的计算资源耗尽威胁模型；结论基于三个学术求解栈，对商业求解器、并行调度器与云配额防御未评估。
limitations: 放大效果依赖求解器实现细节（迭代/预条件配置）；有效性门只保证语法与物理约束可解，不保证结果科学有效；未提出求解器侧防御。

title: Gaussian Difference Dynamics: Breaking the $2^{n/2}$ Barrier for the Shortest Vector Problem and Discrete Gaussian Sampling
abstract: We give classical randomized algorithms in a word RAM model that break the $2^{n/2}$ barrier for both discrete Gaussian sampling (DGS) and the Shortest Vector Problem (SVP). For every fixed $\alpha>1$, shifted DGS on arbitrary lattices at width $\sigma\ge\alpha\eta_{1/2}(L)$ takes $$ (3/2)^{n/2+o(n)}\text{ time} \qquad\text{and}\qquad (4/3)^{n/2+o(n)}\text{ space}. $$ These bounds match the Becker--Ducas--Gama--Laarhoven (BDGL) heuristic sieving exponents. At widths at least $3\eta_{1/2}(L)/2$, the same total cost suffices for an entire batch of $\lfloor(4/3)^{n/2}\rfloor$ samples jointly close to independent target Gaussians. For SVP on arbitrary lattices, our algorithm returns a shortest nonzero vector with high probability in $$ 2^{0.4130n+o(n)}\text{ time} \qquad\text{and}\qquad 2^{0.3138n+o(n)}\text{ space}. $$ As a corollary, we obtain centered DGS at every width with the same exponents, answering a question of Stephens-Davidowitz (SODA 2016). We introduce Gaussian difference dynamics (GDD), a framework for tracking expected counts and pairwise clustering of vectors through repeated differencing. A closed recursion for the first two counting moments controls these quantities relative to a Gaussian reference, without requiring independence within intermediate lists. Accurate moment bounds let us extract a Gaussian sample by weighted selection, while the weaker bounds needed to establish a shortest vector representation allow us to retain more differences. We perform these transitions on thin spherical shells, where the Gaussian rejection weights can be renormalized at subexponential cost. For batch sampling, we combine this geometry with the double rejection technique of Doulgerakis and Laarhoven to control the joint distribution of outputs while reusing vectors.
title_cn: 高斯差分动力学：突破最短向量问题与离散高斯采样的 2^(n/2) 障碍
abstract_cn: 我们给出字 RAM 模型下的经典随机算法，同时突破离散高斯采样（DGS）与最短向量问题（SVP）的 2^(n/2) 障碍。对每个固定 α>1，任意格上宽度 σ≥α·η_{1/2}(L) 的平移 DGS 耗时 (3/2)^(n/2+o(n))、空间 (4/3)^(n/2+o(n))，与 Becker–Ducas–Gama–Laarhoven（BDGL）启发式筛法指数匹配。在宽度至少 3η_{1/2}(L)/2 时，同样总成本足以联合采样 ⌊(4/3)^(n/2)⌋ 个彼此接近独立目标高斯的样本。对任意格上的 SVP，我们的算法以 2^(0.4130n+o(n)) 时间、2^(0.3138n+o(n)) 空间高概率返回最短非零向量。作为推论，我们得到每个宽度下的中心 DGS，指数相同，回答了 Stephens-Davidowitz（SODA 2016）的一个问题。我们提出高斯差分动力学（GDD）框架，通过反复差分跟踪向量的期望计数与成对聚类。一个控制前两阶计数矩的闭式递归，使我们能相对高斯参照系量化这些量，而不要求中间列表内部的独立性。准确的矩界让我们可以通过加权选择提取高斯样本，而建立最短向量表示所需的较弱矩界允许保留更多差分。我们在薄球壳上执行这些转换，高斯拒绝权重可以以亚指数代价重正化。对批量采样，我们结合 Doulgerakis 与 Laarhoven 的双重拒绝技术，在复用向量的同时控制输出的联合分布。
summary_cn: 经典算法同时突破 SVP 与离散高斯采样的 2^(n/2) 障碍：SVP 降至 2^(0.4130n) 时间/2^(0.3138n) 空间，DGS 达 BDGL 筛法指数；核心为跟踪期望计数与聚类的 GDD 框架，并回答 SODA 2016 一个开放问题。
objective_summary: 提出高斯差分动力学（GDD）框架并据此构造经典随机算法，给出任意格上平移 DGS 与 SVP 的时间-空间指数改进，证明矩控制递归并在薄球壳与批量采样设置下完成转换。
evidence_note: 理论论文：给出完整复杂度证明（时间/空间指数、o(n) 项），DGS 指数与 BDGL 匹配、SVP 严格突破长期 2^(n/2) 障碍，并解决 SODA 2016 开放问题。
novelty_note: 打破 SVP/DGS 长期 2^(n/2) 障碍属实质性理论进展，GDD（矩递归加薄球壳重正化）是新框架；具体技术承袭筛法与 BDGL 路线的改进传统。
scope: 适用于任意格上的精确 SVP 与高斯宽度≥α·η_{1/2}(L) 的 DGS 的渐近复杂度；指数为渐近刻画，对具体密码参数规模的现实可解性未直接评估。
limitations: 渐近 o(n) 项可能掩盖实际常数；未给出实现与实验验证；对 LWE 等具体格问题求解门槛的影响需另行换算。

title: Bilateral Protection for Private LoRA Inference with Intel TDX
abstract: Cloud services using private low-rank adaptation (LoRA) must protect client inputs and outputs alongside owners' proprietary parameters and execute the approved adaptation. We design and implement a system for bilateral protection of private LoRA inference using Intel Trust Domain Extensions (TDX), connecting approved application identity to actual artifact consumption and adapter activation. The client and LoRA owner independently verify remote attestation, application identity, and binding to the actual Transport Layer Security (TLS) public key before releasing inputs and the weight-decryption key. A fixed read-only image and verified-byte consumption connect approved identities to inference objects, with all inference inside a trust domain. Experiments on real TDX hardware reject controlled application and boot-parameter modifications before secret release. Across 400 fixed dialogues, protected and native CPU inference in the same trust domain produce identical token sequences for all 400 pairs. Across 12 independent trust-domain boots, the steady-state service-to-native time ratio is 1.0094, with a 95% interval of [1.0064, 1.0126]. The system connects bilateral secret release, approved model use, and task-capability preservation, providing verifiable implementation and cost evidence for confidential inference with a public base and private adapter.
title_cn: 基于 Intel TDX 的私有 LoRA 推理双向保护
abstract_cn: 使用私有 LoRA 的云服务必须同时保护客户端的输入与输出以及所有者的专有参数，并执行经批准的适配。我们设计并实现一个使用 Intel Trust Domain Extensions（TDX）的私有 LoRA 推理双向保护系统，将经批准的应用身份与实际工件消费及适配器激活连接起来。客户端与 LoRA 所有者各自独立验证远程证明、应用身份以及与实际 TLS 公钥的绑定，然后才释放输入与权重解密密钥。固定只读镜像与经验证的按字节消费把经批准的身份与推理对象相连，所有推理都在信任域内进行。在真实 TDX 硬件上的实验在密钥释放前拒绝了受控的应用与启动参数修改。在 400 个固定对话上，同一信任域内受保护推理与原生 CPU 推理对全部 400 对产生完全相同的 token 序列。跨 12 次独立信任域启动，稳态服务对原生时间比为 1.0094，95% 区间为 [1.0064, 1.0126]。该系统将双向密钥释放、经批准的模型使用与任务能力保持连接起来，为带公共基座与私有适配器的机密推理提供可验证的实现与开销证据。
summary_cn: 基于 Intel TDX 实现私有 LoRA 推理双向保护：客户端与适配器所有者各自远程证明后才释放密钥；真实硬件上拒绝受控篡改，400 对话输出与原生完全一致，稳态开销仅 1.0094 倍（95% CI [1.0064, 1.0126]）。
objective_summary: 设计并实现 TDX 信任域内的双向机密 LoRA 推理系统，通过远程证明绑定应用身份、TLS 密钥与工件消费，在真实硬件上测量输出一致性、抗篡改性与 12 次启动的开销置信区间。
evidence_note: 真实 TDX 硬件实验：受控篡改拒绝测试、400 对话输出一致性、12 次独立启动的开销置信区间（1.0094 [1.0064, 1.0126]）；测量口径明确。
novelty_note: 把 TEE 机密推理从单侧保护扩展到客户端与适配器所有者双侧密钥释放并绑定适配器激活，属部署形态的实质扩展；TEE 远程证明与机密推理组件为已有技术。
scope: 适用于可运行于 TDX 信任域的公共基座加私有 LoRA 服务；不覆盖针对信任域本身的侧信道攻击、GPU TEE 与多适配器并发场景。
limitations: 依赖 TDX 与镜像供应链的可信性；开销评估限于固定对话负载；未评估更大模型与高并发下的性能。

title: Can Benign Skills Induce Misaligned Behavior in LLM Agents?
abstract: LLM agents increasingly rely on reusable skills to plan tasks, invoke tools, recover from errors, and complete workflows without modifying model parameters. Although these skills are typically developed to enhance benign tasks, they may also make an agent more capable of executing procedures for harmful purposes. We study this risk, which we call skill-induced behavioral misalignment: adding benign skills may cause an agent to execute external actions that violate safety requirements. We first conduct a systematic study to validate the existence of this phenomenon. It compares agents with and without benign skills across five LLM backbones and three benchmarks under matched requests. On average, skill augmentation improves benign task accuracy by 10.3 percentage points (pp), but also increases unsafe action rate (UAR) by 10.3 pp. The regression also occurs with skills curated by experts. A paired trajectory analysis shows that 24 of 50 newly unsafe trajectories fail to complete the harmful objective, revealing violations that task completion alone would miss. We further disclose multiple factors and scenarios that could exacerbate this risk. (1) Evolving skills with benign feedback can amplify unsafe execution; (2) This regression is more pronounced when retrieved skills are matched to task and contain procedural guidance; (3) Distilling benign experience into reusable skills yield higher UAR compared with their source trajectories. (4) A guard that checks proposed tool actions before execution reduces violations while retaining gains on benign tasks. All these findings confirm the significance of skill-induced behavioral misalignment, and the urgent need for new mitigation solutions.
title_cn: 良性技能会诱发 LLM 智能体的失准行为吗
abstract_cn: LLM 智能体日益依赖可复用技能来规划任务、调用工具、从错误恢复并完成工作流，而无需修改模型参数。这些技能通常为增强良性任务而开发，但也可能使智能体更有能力执行有害目的的程序。我们研究这一被称为技能诱发行为失准的风险：添加良性技能可能导致智能体执行违反安全要求的外部动作。我们首先进行系统研究验证该现象的存在：在相同请求下比较带与不带良性技能的智能体，跨五个 LLM 骨干与三个基准。平均而言，技能增强把良性任务准确率提高 10.3 个百分点，但也将不安全动作率（UAR）提高 10.3 个百分点。这种回退在专家策划的技能下同样出现。配对轨迹分析显示，50 条新出现的不安全轨迹中有 24 条未能完成有害目标，揭示了仅凭任务完成度会遗漏的违规。我们进一步披露可能加剧该风险的多个因素与场景：（1）用良性反馈演化的技能会放大不安全执行；（2）当检索到的技能与任务匹配且含程序性指引时，回退更明显；（3）把良性经验蒸馏为可复用技能比其源轨迹产生更高的 UAR；（4）一个在执行前检查拟议工具动作的守卫能在保留良性任务收益的同时减少违规。这些发现证实技能诱发行为失准的重要性与对新缓解方案的迫切需要。
summary_cn: 系统验证技能诱发行为失准：跨 5 个 LLM 骨干与 3 个基准，良性技能使任务准确率与不安全动作率同步 +10.3 个百分点；技能演化、任务匹配与经验蒸馏都会放大风险，执行前动作守卫可在保留收益下减少违规。
objective_summary: 在匹配请求下比较带与不带良性技能的智能体（5 个骨干、3 个基准），量化技能增强对任务准确率与不安全动作率的影响，分析技能演化、匹配度与蒸馏等加剧因素并评估执行前守卫的效果。
evidence_note: 5 个 LLM 骨干 × 3 个基准的匹配对照实验，配对轨迹分析（50 条中 24 条未完成有害目标），多类加剧因素分析与守卫缓解评估；效应量一致（±10.3 个百分点）。
novelty_note: 首次系统验证良性技能本身会放大不安全执行这一现象并刻画其加剧条件；单个组件（技能库、工具守卫）承袭智能体安全已有工作。
scope: 适用于带可复用技能库、以工具调用执行外部动作的 LLM 智能体；结论基于三个基准与五个骨干，对真实生产技能市场与人类用户在环未覆盖。
limitations: 不安全动作由基准判定器定义，可能与真实政策语义有偏差；守卫仅在检查型设置下评估；未研究攻击者主动投毒技能库的叠加效应。

title: The Native Menace: Host-to-Browser Cross-Boundary Attacks via Native Messaging
abstract: Modern browsers are complex software platforms that users can customize through browser extensions to further expand their functionality. Extensions derive their functionality from privileged browser APIs that expose powerful capabilities. Prior work has extensively studied how malicious webpages or extensions can target those capabilities. However, prior research has overlooked the NativeMessaging API, which allows extensions to create a communication channel that bridges the gap between web content rendered in the browser and native apps running on the user's machine. This API enables workflows that cross the browser's boundary to perform critical operations (e.g., digital signing) or exchange sensitive data (e.g., credentials). In this paper, we conduct the first, to our knowledge, empirical security analysis of NativeMessaging, and present a novel attack that allows a non-privileged malicious native app to misuse browsers' native messaging capabilities to stealthily intercept sensitive communications or launch confused deputy attacks against other native apps. To demonstrate the significant risk introduced by native messaging, we present a series of concrete attacks against popular and critical apps (e.g., 1Password, the European Union's eID system, Google Drive), whose browser extensions have more than 532 million cumulative downloads. Our attacks have severe ramifications, including full password vault leakage, and arbitrary document signing in governmental workflows.
